Audio edition of Weekly Parsha Points - VaYishlach (“He sent”) — Are You Authentic? on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Book of Genesis

VaYishlach (“He sent”)

Are You Authentic ?

Part 1

Last week, in parsha VaYetzei, we read about Jacob leaving his comfortable home and familiar surroundings in Beersheba to go forth to Padan-aram in Mesopotamia, and visit his parents’ relatives. In doing so, Jacob was taking his first steps toward fulfilling his destiny and becoming spiritually transformed in the process.

Real followers pass the test.

Central truth: The Father loves us too much to allow us to remain in the same spiritual place and condition for long, or settle back in familiar but unprofitable comfort zones. He wants us to continue to grow stronger in faith and move unto deeper and more intimate fellowship with Him. Our Messiah spoke to His disciples in this way: “If you abide [ obey, endure, stay in place] in my word, you are truly my disciples.” Understand: What this phrase, “truly my disciples” implies is that there are disciples who are not truly disciples. The word “truly” means “really”--as in ”really my disciples.” In any case, it has been said that a life without duty, discipline, or commitment, i.e. purpose, is bereft of satisfaction and joy. Do you agree?

Created for good works.

In other words there are real and unreal disciples who do not conform to or care about the teaching of Yeshua. There are both authentic and inauthentic disciples in the Church. The imposters are not led by the Holy Spirit. Consider: There is discipleship that is merely outward (a big show), and a discipleship that is faith-filled, inspirational, and completely sincere. So, to which group do you really belong, dear reader. “If you abide [obey] in My Word” is the test. Genuine disciples have eternity in their vision and are positioned for victory and blessing as they grow into overcomers and mature as the Bride of Messiah. See Revelation 2 and 3.

Steps to Discipleship.

This week, in parsha VaYishlach, we read the record of Jacob’s flight from Padan-aram back to Beersheba. However, it appears that his eventful return did not go quite as he had envisioned. The report of his troubled trek back to Canaan could be given this way: “A man’s heart devises the way; but the LORD directs his steps” (Proverbs 16:9). This is very good news for all attentive believers, wouldn’t you say?

The reminder applies to the Christian believers of this age, and also to the descendants of the scattered tribes of the House of Israel who are endeavoring to return to and settle into their Hebraic, Torah-based heritage. This is the birthright blessing attained by believers through their faith in Messiah Yeshua as Savior and sole Mediator of the New Covenant. Hebrews 8:6;12:24. But be informed. Modern saints have been called to contend for [recover and restore] the Torah and Spirit rooted faith that was once delivered to the apostolic, New Covenant Judean Ecclesia (Kahal). Over the centuries however, this faith been compromised, vitiated, and broken apart by false teachings and wandering religious orthodoxies. Determination and endurance are the pre-requisites for recovering the original New Testament apostolic faith and abiding in its truth. This presents a duty to modern disciples.

Parsha VaYishlach (“He sent’)

References: Genesis 32:3-36:43; Hosea 11:7-12:12; Joshua 11:5-19; First Corinthians 5:1-13; Revelation 7:1-12.

Apply the features of Jacob’s journey to your own.

We cannot cover in detail the complete narrative of this rich parsha in our “Points” briefing. However, we will glean relevant lessons from the narrative of Jacob’s journey home to Beersheba. Dear reader, you will be inspired by witnessing his climatic spiritual transformation which occurred during his eventful trek homeward. Goal: Start abiding in the light of divine truth known to you just as the patriarch did when he set out on his arduous journey. You will learn that no matter what resistance or trials you encounter, as you honor Yahweh you will be become transformed as well, but into your Savior’s likeness. Such is a wonderful opportunity, and privilege! Hence it is written: “Trust in YHWH with all thine heart and lean not on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge Him and He shall direct your paths” (Proverbs 3:5-6). So, let’s consider the following six points.

Providential Oversight.

  1. 1. “...return to the land of your fathers..“ (Gen, 31:3). After twenty years of serving his father-in-law Laban in Padam-aram, Yahweh directed Jacob to return to Canaan, the land of his father Abraham. And Jacob went, taking his family and flocks with him, and Yahweh’s reassuring promises, such as: ”I will be with you.” Such an affirmation would be hugely encouraging to any traveler. We have ours too, as we walk the narrow spoken of by Yeshua! Remember Matthew 28:16-20 and Joshua 1:9. Notwithstanding, Jacob left Padan-aram but shortly afterwards was confronted by Laban who pursued him. Their issues were settled with a covenant. Learn: Trust in your Father’s faithfulness and compassionate care, friend, concerning any confrontation or circumstance that suddenly comes upon you.

A heavenly escort. How good is that?

2. “...the angels of God met him“ (32:1). Jacob continued southward to the Jabbok River where heavenly angels, the messengers of Almighty God, intercepted him [fell in with him]. He was informed by his new escort service that Esau was nearby, and to be prepared. Note: This encounter was not just a vision, it was a supernatural manifestation of heavenly ministers. Jacob recognized them as God’s host–or Mananeh. Learn: A heavenly escort is an emblem of angelic guardianship which “encampeth round about them that fear [reverence and trust] the LORD and delivereth them…” and “..keepeth them in all their ways” (Psalms 34 and 91). That includes you, dear reader. You are highly valued and your faith journey is being chaperoned by a heaavenly escort, even now!

Be courageous and strong. Be not dismayed or afraid.

3. “Then the messengers returned...“ (32:6). Having learned of Esau’s approach, Jacob “...sent messengers before him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom’” (B’resheit 32:3). They returned to inform the weary traveler that his brother had 400 armed men with him. Jacob feared violent consequences could occur during this “reunion” so he acted quickly and wisely. The dutiful patriarch divided his family and flocks into two camps behind him. And he prayed, “Oh God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, Oh LORD…deliver me I pray thee”. Jacob prayed with humility and intensity unto YHWH who—as pointed out already, had made wonderful promises to his fathers of which he was the heir. Learn: He says to you personally: “The LORD your God is with you. He is mighty to save. He will take great delight in you, He will quiet you with His love, He will rejoice over you with singing” (Zephaniah 3:17). Reader, hold to your hope.

Give gifts. It Works.

4. “...so he took what came to his hand…” (32:13). Jacob believed the threat he perceived could not actually be reconciled. It appeared to him that the looming rapproachment [the restoration of happy relations] was beyond his ability to handle. So he sought the one who said, “I will surely do good and make your seed as the sand of the sea.” Jacob was given wisdom, the most valuable tool for handling confrontations—i. e., spiritual warfare. Hence, sent a series of gifts–herds and flocks–to soften the temperament of Esau and show respect to his older brother with courteous words, such as referring to him as “my master.” As a result, their meeting was amiable, and after friendly exchanges and assurances they separated. Then Jacob sent his family over the Jabbok tributary but he remained alone. Learn: Kindness and courtesy honor Yahweh and work wonders with your fellow man.

Soft words break bones–stubbornness.

5. “In this manner you shall speak to him…” (32:19). Jacob grew in wisdom and his experience had given him an acute understanding of human nature. He learned that kindness and warm words could soften a hard heart. “I will appease him with a present.” Learn: A repetition of generous presents would act upon Esau in the same way a blacksmith’s hammer, through repeated strikes, shapes the posture of hot iron. There would be a notable effect on the brothers’ reunion by way of Jacob’s wise action–-the fruit of an affectionate reunion. Learn: The Holy One of Israel acknowledges and blesses a generous giver. Remember the poor widow and her two-penny offering? She’s in the Bible’s Hall of Fame for eternity, friend, and rich beyond calculation.

Engage in unrelenting prayer.

6. “Then Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him…” ( 32:22-32). In the verse we witness the mysterious wrestling match between Jacob and a man we interpret to be the visible, physical representation of the invisible Elohim. The confrontation occurred abruptly at a time when Jacob was engrossed in devout, heartfelt prayer. The contest was indeed a physical effort, but foremost it was an intense struggle preoccupying the soul of Jacob. He wanted and needed an enduring blessing, as do many of us today. However, he was given first a dislocated hip, of all thing! Yet Jacob persisted in striving with his heavenly Opponent. Point: Perhaps the dislocated hip was a sign and reminder that Jacob would never succeed in fulfilling his destiny by depending upon his own human strength and carnal temperament. Rather, such would be accomplished only by full reliance on the Almighty. Period. The Contender, allowed Jacob to prevail, and graciously gave him a blessed new name, Israel. It means “one who prevails with God and man.” Learn: Emulate Jacob. Here’s your verse. Live it! “Let us not grow weary in doing good, for in due season we will reap if we don’t give up” (Gal. 6:9). Keep Persevering, blessed reader.

Conclusion of VaYishlach, Part 1

The featured confrontation took place on the north side of the Jabbok river at night where Jacob had been alone, communing in his heart and making supplication and confession. It was at that time of focused prayer the heavenly Visitor suddenly approached him and the physical struggle began. Learn: 1. Set aside an altar time of reading and prayer every day. 2. Increase your attention span. 3. Start listening for His voice. 5. Abide in His Word. Point: Your Elohim, who hears, is bigger than your troubles and stronger than your enemies. He will bless you, reader, according to your need. Therefore, keep seeking his face. Trust His promises. Deepen your relationship with Him, Shaddai–Almighty God—the All Sufficient One. And especially be baptized in the Holy Spirit and Fire. and you will do well. Amen.

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Part 2 is next: It points out the lessons coming out

from Shechem from which we can benefit. Let’s go there together and walk together with Jacob. Hutch Church Shalom.

Book of Genesis

Parsha VaYeitzei (“He went out”)

Personal Transformation. Will you pay the Price?

Part 2

A life-changing encounter for Jacob.

At night, on his return journey home, Jacob came to the River Jabbok. He sent his large

family across the river and was afterwards left alone. Then, as it is written: “... a man

wrestled with him until the breaking of the day.” How the contest started we are not informed. Nevertheless, when the man saw that he did not prevail against Jacob, he put his hip out of socket as they wrestled. Then he said, “Let me go because the day has broken.” But Jacob said, “I will not let you go until you bless me.” And he said, “What is your name?” And the young sojourner said, “Jacob.” Then he said, “Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel, for you have striven with God and man and have prevailed.” Genesis 34:24-28. Note: There are several standards to point out that contributed to Jacob’s transformation into a new man, “Israel.” And these points could inspire you as well, reader, depending on your spiritual ambition of course.

1.The reluctance to release his opponent, even when his thigh joint had been dislocated, indicates Jacob’s unwavering determination to be blessed by God in a meaningful and most needed way. Point: Despite circumstances, a modern saint must also persevere in fervent prayer before the Throne of Grace. The believer is instructed to pray always with “all prayer and supplication in the Spirit” (Ephesians 6:18).

2. Jacob was given a new name, Israel. It makes a statement that Jacob was one who would strive with the Almighty until he prevailed. Point: Friend, do likewise! Set your course to excel as an overcomer. Strive with Yahweh to be blessed in this worthy campaign and you will also receive a new name from Yeshua, your High Priest. Revelation 2:17!

3. Jacob was spiritually elevated by the blessing bestowed upon him and came to understand the importance of God’s favor and his need for providential care. Point: Seek to honor Him in all things. Learn to be led and instructed by the Holy Spirit.. Wisdom is a weapon of warfare. Ephesians 1:18!

4. The circumstances of his previous years had changed Jacob, yet the Jabbok River event positioned Jacob in a higher spiritual level altogether. Jacob embraced the true God and His precepts as did His father Isaac, and grandfather, Abraham. [Their instruction likely came from Shem who was alive at that time.] Point: Jacob learned obedience. New Covenant saint, grow up and learn obedience too. There’s no room for hypocrisy in your quest to rank among the blessed overcomers. You may also have divine, life-changing divine encounters with Elohim, your Creator. Expect to hear His voice by the Spirit and encounter His presence in a discernable way. Get baptized in the Holy Spirit. See: Acts 1:1-9 and 2.1-47; 10:44-46; 19:6; 1 Cor. 14.

Follow Yahweh’s truth, not the endless banter humans.

Obedience is not legalism. It is the pure, biblical demonstration of faith and love for our Creator and Redeemer. You and I can spend months – pursuing and engaging political conflicts, advancing technology, assorted ideologies, financial upheavals and their threats, war, and religious inventions and controversies, to cite a few common preoccupations. But all that stuff will, in time, become repetitive and wearisome. Point: As Solomon realized as he drew close to his death, man’s chief duty is to obey God’s sacred Word. Our battle’s core is spiritual–always. If we won’t follow our Master after “His manner,” we will continue to abide under a demonic curse. Selah. 2 Chronicles 7:14 waits to be fiulfilled. “If my people, who are called…” You know the rest. But did you know that without obedience to known, applicable, and doable Scriptural truth there is no real repentance and no true discipleship? Pray. Wait upon the Spirit of Truth to come alongside you. And remember the plight of King Saul.

Peniel:

Did you know that locations can leave an impression on people that causes changes in their world view, stirs introspection, and even inspires personal development. Thus the Almighty chooses appropriate places for His work with people. Jacob named the place of his encounter with the heavenly wrestler, Peniel. The generally accepted meaning of the name is: For I have seen God face to face. However, since no human can see Elohim’s face and live, the name could refer to a close, spiritually intimate interaction. Keep in mind, friend. You can do your own research and decide for yourself concerning anything written in our blogs. This has always been our counsel concerning what Contenders Voice ministries happen to teach.

Note: Following this amazing visitation, an existential work of grace, Jacob went forward fully prepared to meet and be reconciled with his once-hostile brother, Esau.

The Torah is the standard of Discipleship

The study of the Torah is essential for Christians, and everyone else, for that matter. The Torah’s origin is divine, it is not restricted, but has a universal application. “It has been evident that believers, including preachers, often interpret the Bible through the lens of their culture, worldview, and public education. This has resulted in many misleading religious beliefs, doctrines and practices becoming prevalent in the Christianity that are not in accord with the clear and pure teachings of the holy Scriptures. Lamentably, this is often the case with the evangelical church in the United States. This country is strongly influential across the globe. Hence, the American evangelical system has also produced a strong influence worldwide. This has occurred by the exportation of a westernized gospel replete with an American pattern of faith that is not in line with the Hebraic paradigm of Scripture. Consequently, in the United States pulpit preaching usually comes across looking more like “American Dream” and “Self-actualization” lessons than the Torah-based and Spirit-powered Gospel. Unabridged, expository proclamations are what is needed now. VaYetzei’s related three closing points should find applications in your own lives, my persistent friends.

He will visit you.

Point 1. “Jacob departed…and encountered a place and spent the night there…” (10-11). The location of Jacob’s encounter with Yeshua was Mount Moriah, the site where Abraham bound Isaac on the altar and where the Temple would later stand. Point: For disciples to desire a visitation of the Holy One of Israel is biblical. Learn: Jacob is a type of each one of us who is awakening and coming to our biblical heritage. The ladder in his dream is seen as Yeshua’s cross of atonement which was situated on earth and still reaches into heaven, for it was the divine mediator who was sacrificed upon it. He now stands above the cross and speaks to the heirs of salvation–His chosen: “I will never leave you.” Point: In our own journeys to our prescribed destinies may our daily times of prayer, praise, study, and service result in divine encounters with Elohim at the gate of glory. Moses pleaded :“Please show me your glory.” Yahweh responds: “I will do this very thing you have asked…” (Exodus 33:18). Moses had found favor in God’s sight. WHY? What’s your answer?

You are sent also. What is your purpose?

Point 2. “And he went out…” Jacob’s life teaches attentive believers that each of us has

a familiar past, an old life, a family and even a religion of some sort from which we must separate in order to go forward and accept the challenge of pursuing Yahweh’s prophetic truth and make our own contribution to the restoration of all things spoken of by the prophets–including both the houses of Israel. Learn: When Jacob went out to face his tests of faith and pursue his destiny, Elohim’s voice spoke to him, personally assuring Jacob that the Most High Elohim would be in continual attendance with him in his pilgrimage just as He was with his fathers. Point: As Jacob was sent by Isaac, each saint today has been sent forth by their Good Shepherd, Yeshua. “Go ye therefore…and I am with you…” (Matthew 28:18-20).

Transformative, purifying Holy Fire

Point 3. Reader, you have a heavenly Helper! Yield to His leading. It is written: “But when he, the Spirit of Truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he will not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will show you things to come” (John 16:3). Learn: For New Testament saints to be changed from a Jacob into an Israel we need an internal spiritual fire. Hence, every saint would do well to be baptized by Yeshua with the Holy Spirit, as I mentioned earlier. This experience is a gift that (1) gives power and (2) enhances faith and zeal for the recipients to live for Yeshua and follow His instructions.

Get Zeal !

Our High Priest, Yeshua, is the Kingdom’s Lawgiver. Some of His modern saints are beginning to love the Father’s precepts, judgments, testimonies, statutes, and commandments exceedingly. It is fitting. Point: Because of their faith in and love for their Shepherd, His followers (sheep) want to live zealously by His laws and standards, i.e., boldly follow His instructions. See Romans 16:25-26; Hebrews 10:16).

Cross over to New Wine

One of Jacob’s “life lessons” shows us that although each believer in Messiah Yeshua has a familiar past, an old life, a family, or even a religion, we must separate from old, unholy influences. This is called sanctification--being set apart for Yahweh purposes. It is necessary for advancing forward and meeting the challenge of pursuing Yahweh’s prophetic word. Our call is to make a contribution to the restoration of all things spoken of by the prophets (Acts 3:21). When Jacob left his family and went out to face his tests of faith and pursue his destiny, Elohim spoke to him, personally. Jacob was assured that the Most High would be in continual attendance with him in his pilgrimage, just as He was with his fathers. Point: As Jacob was sent by Isaac, each New Covenant, Spirit-born believer in Yeshua is sent also, and accompanied by His Spirit. It is written: “He will not let your foot slip–he who watches over you will not slumber” (Psalm 121:3-4). Therefore, reader, cast your anxieties on Him. He cares for you. So go forward on your faith pathway to spiritual maturity. Review Matthew 28:18-20; Hebrews 6:1-3.

Our job: Teach His people to obey His precepts and judgments.

It is the Messiah’s will that the truth, standards, and principles of His Law [His teaching; instructions for life and worship] would be fulfilled in the lives of His followers (Romans 3:31; 8:4). Understand: Our High Priest, Yeshua, is the Kingdom’s Lawgiver. His modern saints are awakening spiritually and beginning to love the Father’s precepts, judgments, testimonies, statutes, and commandments exceedingly. It is fitting. Point: Because of their faith in and love for their Shepherd, His followers (sheep) want to live by His laws and standards, i.e., to follow His instructions. See Romans 16:25-26 and Hebrews 10:16. This is His way!

We will continue to study Jacob’s life in greater detail in the next five parshas of Genesis by highlighting its most relevant features. It is profitable to first understand how the patriarch’s life, social status, and prophetic family vision relate to that of believers today–which includes you and myself, your Parsha Points host. Next week’s Parsha is VaYishlach (“And he sent”). Its narrative covers Jacob and his family’s flight from Beersheba to Padan-aram. We will glean helpful, personally advantageous lessons from this parsha.

Until next week, here’s a prophetic Scripture and a poem for you to read and contemplate.

“Ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein.”

Jeremiah 6:16

What does that mean to you?

Learn Faith and Works are Bonded

Exhortation # 1: Examine the Word of Yahweh.

As you go forward through the site's teachings and blogs, keep in mind that Contender's Voice encourages each person to emulate the study habits of the venerable Berean Jews of Northern Greece. They attended a synagogue in ancient Berea that was being visited by Apostle Paul. While there, he regularly presented the Gospel to the Greek and Judean attendees. Among those in the ancient congregation at that time were ardent Jewish congregants, men who were eager to learn as much about the acclaimed Jewish Messiah as they possibly could. Thus, they carefully examined their Old Covenant scrolls daily to determine if what Paul--the Israelite missionary, taught them about Yeshua was validated by the Torah--and accurate. They were not disappointed. Indeed, Paul's bold proclamations proved entirely trustworthy, since the apostle's teaching was consistently based upon the Jewish Tanakh, the Hebrew Bible--Judaism's fundamental text. So it appears that these Jewish men were seeking confirmation from Yahweh's Torah for transitioning from rabbinic Judaism to the Messiah-based Nazarene faith. Many of them became enlightened and believed Paul's doctrinal presentation of the crucifixion, death, burial, and resurrection of Yeshua, the divine Son of Elohim. Accordingly, a goodly number of those studious and inspired seekers would be (1) converted and become Spirit-born disciples through faIth in Yeshua the Messiah, (2) go on to mature in the impeccable apostolic "faith once for all delivered to the saints" and, most likely, (3) grow in grace and go on to bear much fruit of the Spirit throughout their lives. See: John 3:7; 15:7-8; Jude 1:3.

Exhortation # 2: Emulate the Bereans of Macedonia. 1.5 Minutes

Today's earnest followers of Yeshua are facing a similar type of situation as did the Bereans long ago. I am sure you are aware, dear visitor, that there is a Hebraically centered, Torah restoration movement underway in our nation--of which Contender's Voice is a committed advocate and contributor. In fact, it is a grace-oriented, prophetically-timed Torah-centric revival that is capable of satisfying the fundamental spiritual need of modern believers. And that dire need would be the restoration of the unabridged, full expanse of holy Scripture to the westernized Body of Messiah. Hence, the Holy Spirit is leading these prophetic saints first--to Elohim's unmixed truth, and secondly--to the duty and benefit of un-compromised sanctification. Be sure of this, beloved contender--consecration to Torah-rooted sacred truth is Yahweh's expectation for our lives. Matthew 5:6. Consequently, many believers who know and love Yeshua as their Messiah are measuring this historic Torah recovery phenomenon for possible participation and support. In conclusion, this ministry recommends that every reader of our Web site, manuals, and books follows the example of the Bereans. First, study the Scriptures faithfully under the tutelage of the Holy Spirit. Secondly, prayerfully evaluate everything you read on this site (and others) by comparing it with Yahweh's Word. Thirdly, decide for yourself the validity of the content. Finally, endeavor to honor and fully comply with the truth that (a) Yahweh has made known to you, (b) is applicable to you, and (c) is understood and doable by you. In this way you will be blessed in all your doing. Here's your promise: "For the LORD is a sun and a shield; the LORD bestows favor and honor. No good thing will He withhold from those who walk uprightly" (Psalm 18:11). Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Shalom.

"Everyone should submit to the governing authorities, as there is no authority except that which God has established" (Rom. 13:1).

In September, 1965, I stepped down from a Greyhound bus at the notorious Parris Island Marine Corps Recruit Depot in South Carolina. And behold! I was immediately greeted by a very large yellow sign with bold red lettering on it. So too were the other wide-eyed recruits who accompanied me. The sober wording declared: "The Marine Corps demands Discipline, Devotion to Duty, and Teamwork." The words requests, please, and thank you were conspicuously absent. Hence, I saw this in-your-face "hello" not merely as a (1) strong recommendation, but for what is really was--a (2) foreboding, Old Corps prime directive to be taken literally and very seriously. At that time I had no idea that the Marine Corps' espoused basic standards for recruits were compatible with Scripture's requirements for aspiring disciples of Yeshua. See Matthew 16:24. Anyway, the unfriendly introduction caused my apprehension level concerning the future to spike! This took place during the days of the unforgiving Old Corps, with its stifling wooden barracks, biting sand fleas, heavy M-14 rifles, and other unpleasantries. Yet, by bearing the burdens of discipline, recruits learned to understand and respect the important role of duty in life.

Obedience to Holy Scripture is the Biblical Expression of Love, Faith, and Worship.

Nevertheless, having been (a) deposited on the inhospitable island--a place from which no recruits had ever successfully escaped, and my (b) vowed commitment to military service being irreversible, I took the large, intimidating red words to heart and went forward mentally prepared to comply with the austere demands of the new chapter of life I had chosen. But unknown to me, my forbearance with the Corps' dominance--and the subsequent rigors of Vietnam, initiated a gradual inner transformation that would contribute to conditioning me years later for a life-changing encounter with the Holy Spirit, and conversion to the Messiah. Beforehand however, I learned quickly how serious the Corps really was concerning its posted fundamental requirements. The yellow sign's stern message was indeed inflexible and vigorously enforced, as if it had been "etched in stone." There was no mincing of words; no equivocation! The matter was settled and there would be no "about face." Recruits-all who had vowed loyalty to the constitution and the service, would (a) learn and (b) march in cadence to ALL the Corps pertinent regulations and fulfill their duties in a satisfactory fashion! Yeshua's dedicated followers are distinguished by their (a) separation from following worldly ideologies, circular philosophies, New Age beliefs, and faulty moral standards and their (b) compliance instead to His instructions and teachings alone. Indeed, may all His followers be spiritually elevated by becoming genuine disciples who hear His commands with wise and submitted hearts. Yet the question arises: Which of Elohim's commandments do we obey for there are many. That's true. The Torah contains hundreds of moral, ceremonial, civil and national laws. Someone may therefore think that obeying the greatest laws is more important that striving to honor the least of the laws. But is that so? The greatest law, according the our Torah teacher, Yeshua, is found in Deuteronomy 6: 5, where it is written: "You shall love the LORD you God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength." This command is foremost and well known. It is accomplished by love-motivated believers obeying His instructions--all that are known to them, understood, applicable, and doable. That would be the starting point, so to speak. But what about the lesser known laws in the Torah? Are they important as well? Yes, they are! All God's laws reflect His sublime, holy character and agape love for His creation and all those abiding within it. So let's examine a couple of the lesser known laws and discover that their purpose is connected to honoring YHWH and even loving our neighbor, as are the better known ones. Leviticus 19:18. John 14:15-21.

"If you happen to come upon a bird's nest along the way...you shall not take the mother with the young, but the young you may take...in order that it may be well with you and that you may prolong your days" (22: 6-7).

The Jewish commentator Rambam cited two reasons for this unusual prohibition: (1) It is cruel to kill a mother and its young together, on the same day (Lev. 22:28). (2) The statute implied that Israelites must be restrained from endangering any species of animals, which could happen if there were no restrictions on slaughtering a mother animal with its young. Contender's Voice adds: (3) The female sex makes motherhood and the propagation of young possible, and binds one generation to the next. Thus, the command to spare the mother bird is significant, for the principle conveys the same consideration to other species of animals, and also accentuates the verse (v. 5) it follows concerning differentiating between the sexes. (4) The mother was spared for a purely practical reason: because the female is needed for continuing the propagation [increase in numbers] of birds, and maintaining their population. Birds were needed! They kept down bugs, insects, and grubs, and even helped pollinate the fields. (5) The statute, which rendered motherhood sacred in the woods, helped remind Israel how much more should motherhood be sacred in the nation. A mother should be honored by her children. To the perceptive, the seemingly insignificant law taught that the young should bear the burdens, not the old. (6) Then, there is the law prohibiting boiling (seething) a kid in its mother's milk, that is thrice repeated in Scripture, and relates to the "nest" statute. See: Exodus 23:19; 34:26, and Deut. 14:21.

The three-fold repetition of the law indicates its importance in helping to keep awake the sense of propriety and respect for life in the soul of the nation. There are various explanations for this statute, but upon this there is agreement: It is "...a protest against cruelty, and outraging [of] the order of nature, more especially the peculiarly sacred portion of nature's order, the tender relation between parent and child, mother and suckling. No doubt the practice existed. [Goat] kids were thought more palatable [tasty] when boiled in milk; and the mother's milk was the readiest to obtain. But in this way the mother was made sort of [an] accomplice in the death of her [young], which men were induced to kill on account of the flavor that her milk gave it...but feeling revolts from it, and [so does] the general sense of civilized mankind..." Eerdmans, Book of the Covenant, p. 203. Following these commands fulfills all the instructions of the Torah and thus comprise "mighty deeds." He demonstrated his love for God and neighbors by committing to preserve Yahweh's sacred Word amidst a flood of false teaching. Their Torah doctrines and traditions were recognized to be God-given, entirely relevant, easy to bear, and hence had long been maintained in tact and kept in circulation. It's a double edged sword, actually, that spews out volumes of deceptive misinformation thereby impugning the integrity of the holy Scriptures, misdirecting seekers with wearisome philosophies and social theories, and obfuscating the Gospel of salvation. The weight of modern media output also militates against pure biblical faith and it's life-changing prophetic vision, and thereby divides the nominal Church into thousands of organizations and the Bible into many interpretations and arguments. A spiritual, Torah-based restoration is needed in the Ecclesia--the Called Out Assembly, wouldn't you agree? A "Truth Revival" highlighting Yeshua, the fullness of the Torah, the complete ministry of the Holy Spirit, and discipleship is our need. Hence, the Elohim of Israel reminds the saints of the purity of His holy Word with this countervailing encouragement: "For these commands are a lamp and this teaching is light; and the reproofs of discipline are the way to life" (Proverbs 6:23). Selah. Hold up His Word over your path each day. Now, lets go visit the Four Essentials together----take on one per day if you'd like! They are the heaven-ward steps of crossing over and abiding in the victory wrought for us by the atonement, shed blood, and resurrection of our blessed Messiah, Yeshua.

Four Essentials.

First, It is written: "I tell you the truth, no one can see the Kingdom of God unless he is born again [regenerated by the Holy Spirit]" (John 3:3). Heed the instructions of John's Gospel. Everyone coming to Messiah and the Kingdom of God must be (a) convinced of His divine Sonship, (b) surrendered entirely to the sacred truth vouchsafed by the Holy Spirit, and (c) assured of salvation in Messiah by faith alone--and be born-again. This is a spiritual "birth" occurring within someone being regenerated by the Holy Spirit, who puts Yahweh's law in the mind and on the heart. This spiritual phenomenon is wonderful and miraculous. This foretold blessing written of by Jeremiah, Ezekiel, and Joel, is experienced by "whosoever believeth in Him," the Son, Messiah Yeshua --as Savior. It is written in Ephesians 2:8-9: "For you are saved by grace through faith; it is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God." Further the convert, at the moment of salvation and the new birth, is "...delivered from the kingdom of darkness and translated into the kingdom of light" (see Colossians 1:13-17). The spiritual crossover results in the convert being redeemed from satanic power and becoming a new creation in Messiah, and subject only to the instructions, goodness and freedom of God.

Secondly, it is written: "...and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free" (John 8:32). Let's clarify that verse. The truth of God must be studied and understood in order to liberate one's mind from fear, evil thoughts, and deception, and inspire them to follow the Way--the teachings of Messiah and all His apostles. However, freedom is completed, if you will, and sustained once the believer begins to comply with Yahweh's truth. Separation from sin and turning to righteousness is called -- sanctification. It is alluded to in Psalm 91 as "dwelling in the secret place of the Most High". The hearer simply must become a doer of the Word. To practice what we have learned is a duty and a privilege for every saint. Obedience to known and doable instruction is the key that opens the trailhead of the disciples journey with Messiah. It's an essential! Paul describes His mission in both the beginning and ending of Romans: It was "...to bring about the obedience of faith among all the Gentiles for His name's sake..." See Roman 1:5 and Romans 16:26 also. Re-read Matthew 28:19-20.

Thirdly, it is written: The resurrected Messiah spoke to His followers before His ascension and said: " ...wait for what the Father had promised, which He said, you heard of from Me; for John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit not many days from now" (Acts 1:4-5) and "...you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you; and you shall be my witnesses..." (verse 8). Be baptized in the Holy Spirit. This blessing satisfies the need for purification, power, and enthusiasm for believing disciples, and falls in step with the words of John the Baptist concerning the Messiah's ministry. "He will baptize you with the Holy Sprit and fire" (Matthew 3:11). Amen. Have you, blessed reader, been baptized by Yeshua with the Holy Spirit?

Fourthly, it is written: "Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations..." (Matthew 28:19). Become a disciple of our Messiah and coming King, Yeshua, and a servant of His purposes, foremost of which is making disciples. . It takes a disciple to "make disciples." Do not remain a convert or nominal believer, but enroll in His "School of Faith" as a committed student of His truth and diligently follow all the applicable instructions of our Messiah. The disciples goal is to become like his or her teacher and devoted adherent of the teacher's words! [Question: Doesn't everyone abide by some set of rules, values, words, or a general body of information--be they subjective, objective, an eclectic philosophic, ideologic, or new age mystical blend ? Yes! We all follow some sort of paradigm that shapes our lives and determines our eternity. So, with whose words or teaching are you building your life and legacy upon? Who do you really want to emulate? Be honest. Share your ideas.] It is written: "...if you love me, keep my commandments" (John 14:15). Here Yeshua clearly tells us that obedience to His commands, His instructions--is the foremost way a believer can steadfastly express unfeigned love for him. Again, a disciple is the student who wants to learn from and become like his or her teacher. Of whom are you a disciple, dear reader? Being a disciple of the Messiah requires a life-long commitment.

Paul wrote these words to Timothy and to you and me also: "Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of God" (2 Timothy 2:15). We are converted, born again, and saved to become disciples of Yeshua, dedicated students of His Torah and fervent for lawfulness. His genuine disciples are not at all inclined to be unschooled, spiritually ill-prepared converts who pick and choose "comfy" Bible verses to follow. This set-apart status to which we are summoned is a privilege. His words put faith, love, truth, and power in a disciple's heart and are the great disciplinarians of His "school of faith, hope, and love. They are holy chaperons of our lives, guardians of purity of heart and mind, and the relentless enemies of demonic deceptions. His sacred laws must be honored at all times. This bond to His instructions is expected by all who are preparing to be His Bride! Do you regard yourself as a true disciple of the Master? Do you honor the Sabbath of which He is LORD? If not, don't let Catholic doctrine, of which Protestantism is an offspring, turn you away from the Sabbath. Keep the Seventh Day. It's the only day in the Torah that was given a name by Yahweh. It is written as your assurance, blessed saint: "And we know in all things God works for the good of those who love Him, who have been called according to His purpose" (Romans 8:28). It is a sign uniting Yahweh and His people in close fellowship. Good things lie ahead for you. Amen.

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward.

Hutch Church. Shalom.

Part One

There is one faith which YHWH has completely sanctioned, fully honored, and entrusted to His apostolic saints–-for them to guard and proclaim until the second coming of the risen King of Glory occurs. It is comprised of His words of life–the Scriptures, which have pretty much covered the earth. His faith–some refer to it as orthodoxy, is the only one to pass muster, so to speak! The Book of Acts reveals this faith being embraced by the original Nazarene Israelites. It is the way of victory over sin, death, and evil forces. And it is Torah-based, Spirit empowered, and Messiah centric. So, with that in mind, let’s unpack this topic–-the “Victory of Faith,” by taking a trip down memory lane to review and consider something Israel achieved in the Wilderness on their march to Canaan…and what it means to us today.

The accounts of ancient Israel’s adventures that the nation encountered, as it advanced through hostile Amorite territory on its way to the Promised Land, supplies modern believers with profound testimonies of the love and faithfulness of Yahweh. Indeed, Israel’s Elohim inspired faith, imparted wisdom, and infused military prowess to His people according to their need especially when facing hostilities. He thereby enabled them to fulfill His instructions and continue forward to their assigned destiny–-under providential oversight. So, here is one event we shall consider. It is written: "We turned and went up the road to Bashan: and Og the King of Bashan came out against us..." (De. 3:1-11). Og was a genuine giant. The massive Rapha’im King, who was considerably larger than Goliath, was a formidable and merciless pagan adversary. [Note: The gargantuan Amorite slept on an iron-framed bed of about 13.5 to 14 feet in length and 6 feet wide. It might have been larger, actually, since Rabbinic tradition holds that the cubit measurements were of the giant’s proportions, not those of a smaller, common human. See 1] He ruled a vast area–-the region of Argob which was populated with giants. It held sixty cities that were built upon basaltic rock with strong black stones. Hence, the districts and towns of Bashan were ominous, threatening, and impregnable in appearance. Consequently, Og and his daunting Nephilim forces would, at first glance, look unconquerable…to anyone. Insurmountable. Still, by faith in their Elohim, Israel went forward to engage the overly confident, intimidating army...and annihilated it. This makes Israel's sudden, complete, and decisive defeat of Og and his kingdom, which was so heavily populated, powerfully defended, geographically favored, and ruled by a company of giants--so utterly astonishing. As a result of their great conquest the Israelites’ confidence and courage levels spiked upward, as did fear of the Israeli multitudes surge in the hearts of the surrounding nations that lay in their path. Og had come out with all his people fully armed against the Israelites. He was nevertheless promptly and completely routed. The conquered land and the cities were taken and possessed by Israel who met the conditions for such success, which are: (a) fearlessness--"Be strong and courageous..." (Joshua 1:6) and (b) faith, i.e. dependence on the Almighty for divine assistance–-"Trust in the LORD with all thine heart...” (Prov. 3:5). What does this paragraph have to do with my life today, you ask? It serves as a reminder that, though our adversities may be foreboding, they can indeed be overcome.

Consider the power and extent of lawlessness and gross immorality existent in our nation, for instance. America was once a republic of lawfulness, moral rectitude and behavioral normality. The culture has been changed however, by the flood of mixed media transmission infiltrating our institutions, and the resultant spreading of spiritual wickedness and its compliant human minions. We are now inhabited by a population that harbors mixed standards for living–-many of whom have been given over to woke values and reprobate, unholy thinking. We must have a full-fledged biblical revival accompanying the restoration of the republic if we expect to prevail. See Romans 1. Our fouled social condition is itself an adversary of decency and godly morality. Notwithstanding, the new administration recognizes the problem and is taking steps to restore moral and social normalcy to the nation. This is a good initial effort for change. But the real enemy is the spiritual component underlying the nation's spiritual and secular corruption. This enemy cannot be defeated by human weapons. To gain a strong and enduring victory spiritual weapons must be employed by fervent restoration contenders of Yahweh’s genuine apostolic faith. This step will initiate a cure of the spiritual and moral plague. But is there a countervailing force to which we have access that cannot be defeated? Absolutely! Is there a way people can vanquish the widespread underlying dark spiritual forces energizing and directing the demonic upheaval? Yes, there is! We saints procure Yahweh’s intervention and blessing by abiding in His sacred instructions–that means keeping His commands-all that are known, applicable, and doable at this time and thereby dislodging the elements of spiritual darkness. Those given in 2 Chronicles 7:14 and Ephesians 6:10-18 provide the wisdom–a foremost weapon of warfare, and the needed tools and responsibilities for restoration contenders..

Bolstered by such a commitment we contenders could take Paul’s words to heart: “For I can do everything through [faith in] the Messiah who gives me strength” (Phil. 4:13). Yeshua is our High Priest, ever interceding for His saints before the throne of the Father. Did you know that Yeshua is cited by the first word, of the first verse, of the first page, of the first chapter, of the first book of the Torah–Beresheit. Yeshua is the resheit of beresheit! It means first fruits, beginnings, the source, firstly, best, and inception–all of which point to the living Torah, Yeshua our blessed Messiah. He is first in all blessed things. And be sure of this! He wants–and is entitled to, first place in our lives also. No other place will do.

Our spiritual warfare tactics, listed in Ephesians 6:10-18, include using the Word of God as a two edged sword by proclaiming it openly, boldly, and vocally while in prayer And do so in the face of life’s carnal challenges and infernal temptations. Remember David! Re-read the account in First Samuel. David declared to the face of the giant, Goliath, “I come against you in the name of the LORD Almighty, the God of the armies of Israel…” (1 Samuel 17:45). The young man’s bold and true declaration of faith set the stage for victory. The giant fell dead and the Philistines fled the battlefield. In any case, we can see clearly that He has good things ahead for you, dear reader–promises He has yet to fulfill. Therefore, let’s repent of debilitating worldliness and pray, become sanctified, and persist in proclaiming our alliance with Yeshua and His truth in the face of demonic conflict. Believers today–-if they align with divine instructions, are destined to be overcomers as were Moses and Israel long ago, and King David also. Remember, Yeshua has already won the victory. In rebuilding a broken nation on a sure biblical foundation–-such faith will be required. Tamid Kadima-Always Forward

Part Two

“Ask for the ancient paths…and walk therein…” (Jer. 6:16).

In the verse posted above we hear the prophet Jeremiah speaking to Judah long ago to turn away from their lawbreaking and idolatry and return to the old paths, the good ways of the Torah. His ancient words find room in modern, backslidden America also. The call of the prophet Hosea is also beginning to be heard again. His words went forth to the wayward, sinful people of Israel. The order was made long ago–-”Return O Israel to YHWH your Elohim, for you have stumbled and fallen [visited with mounting troubles] because of your sin” (Hosea 14:1). The appeal was made to the Northern Kingdom of Israel but has applications for Yahweh's covenant saints today, even in America, who hope for a cultural restoration but are currently abiding in a corrupted nation. It is a last hour summons to come back to the path of Scripture’s foundations of truth! Call it a life line thrown out to floundering swimmers struggling in the cold waters of a Nor’easter storm. It’s a metaphor pointing to restoring the republic’s rule of law along biblical lines. Wisdom will especially be needed during the period of building a golden age society for America, especially as AI technology becomes its nervous system, if you will, and transhumanism emerges as the over-shadowing cultural influence. Let us therefore remember–the pathway to wisdom, and a victorious spiritual and moral change for the nation, is founded in the exercise of biblical faith! It is the core of spiritual warfare.

While the administration’s executive orders are initiating beneficial governmental changes in America ….and national hope for a restoration of normalcy has risen. But we remain in the throes of social conflict, lawlessness, and gross cultural decline. Our depraved, deeply ingrained societal condition has progressed to the point that’s beyond the scope of human repair and resuscitation. We know this, I’m sure. Thus, divine intervention must be invoked by repentant people across the nation, in order to reinforce recovery efforts, don’t you think? In a nutshell, the nation is spiritually conflated and politically conflicted. Behind the temporal scene we see the institutional westernized church, tasked by the Almighty for preserving and proclaiming pure biblical truth, but ill-equipped to do so. That Torah-based faith which was taught and followed by the early, apostolic Ecclesia, started to become disfigured long ago. Consequently, because of misleading errant teachings and customs that entered the expanding Ecclesia, this responsibility has not been followed for many centuries. Christendom has become spiritually ill-prepared for the most part, and no longer holds a strong full-biblical influence on western people. Institutional Christianity, aside from its history of missions and social good works, is an entity that has drifted far away from its original Hebraic heritage and hence has given up much spiritual strength and scriptural truth potential for guidance and service. In the days of the apostles, Jude the Nazarene elder of the early assembly, recognized the growing problem of false teaching and the assault on Hebraic costumes as serious problems that needed immediate attention. He wrote this edict: “Contend for the [pure, unmixed] faith once for all delivered (entrusted) to the saints” (1:3). He urged the Judean believers to vigorously defend the truth taught by Yeshua and the Apostles. Among the costs of the dilution of sacred truth was a diminished potential for gaining spiritual victory over the works of darkness–then and now also. This is a modern day Og situation…and we are Yahweh’s ingrafted, Spirit-born Israelites with a destiny of our own to fulfill! Do we repent, pray, become sanctified, and fulfil our contender role to oppose the spiritual enemy? Or faint and abide mired in deceptions? Tell me what you think, dear reader? Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Parts 3 and 4 are next. They review the Victory by Faith that comes through our Redeemer, Messiah Yeshua. So, let’s meet at the next post. Hutch Church

Welcome back, blessed readers. I have some “just in case” questions for each of us to consider, and by which we can examine our lives. So here we go. Are you tired of being overcome by sin, the lust of both the flesh and the eyes, the power of self-pride, and the world's unholy enticements? Could such a debilitating, ingrained tendencies—abiding weaknesses actually, be the natural result of ignoring the validity of the Torah coupled with imbibing biblical instruction that deviates from sound exegesis and assumes many forms. Yes, indeed. That’s a double-edged problem. Inaccurate and biased Bible teaching fails to undergird the believers’ faith, impedes acquiring an accurate, functionable knowledge of Scriptures, and hinders developing a friendship-fellowship with Yeshua, our High Priest. In fact, misleading Bible teaching has misrepresented Yeshua, who—while on earth, was not a westerner but rather a Jewish Torah teacher and Sabbath keeper. He was born in Bethlehem, raised in Nazareth, and His earthly lineage runs through the royal House of David. What’s more, denominational teaching is known for depleting the saints’ spiritual potential by turning them away from their Hebraic heritage and identity. Wouldn’t this tendency distort our prophetic vision concerning the restoration of all Israel and our role as contenders of the original apostolic faith? Yes, again. So, if you easily cave in to temptation and are troubled by demonic powers who have relative freedom to come and go in your life, its time for a big change—that of crossing over from being a “harmed and harassed victim” to living as a “triumphant victor”! This is the inheritance of true believers and should be our experience and fulfilled destiny. Ask yourself, dear believer—in spite of the good intentions of many faith organizations, is everything you have been taught by your “religious fellowship” actually true? Dependable? Entirely reliable? And have you not been clearly taught that residing under the spirit of Mystery Babylon—which permeates America, is a major cause of the plague of lawlessness and the problem of spiritual apathy that (a) leaven the nation’s secular and spiritual institutions and (b) keep many of the nation’s people—religious though we be, under a demonic spell and biblically short-sighted?

Have you not fled from this unseen but very real spiritual smog–- as we have been commanded. See Jeremiah 50, 2 Corinthians 6:17; 18:3, and Revelation 18:4. Has fighting the “good fight of faith,” as did Apostle Paul for instance, found no place in our bucket lists? If so, discover the standing and readily available alternative to being spiritually bullied. Awaken to the reality of maturing an overcomer of such spiritual challenges by reading about the viability of victory-for-the-saints that has been provided by Yahweh through His Son and set in place for centuries. The victory-of-faith is the topic discussed in this post. The means of understanding and establishing the foundation of victory will be placed before us to contemplate. But keep in mind, as Contender’s Voice considers the modern condition of Yeshua’s faith-once-delivered-to-the-saints, we will expose those matters which are hindrances to overcoming spiritual wickedness and endorse that which is necessary and beneficial to living victoriously. And you, of course, are free to decide for yourselves the validity of our presentation. Here we go.

It is written: “...and this is the victory that has overcome the world–our faith” (1 John 5:4)

Speaking in broad strokes–-faith can be defined as a deeply held trust in religious beliefs and customs. And it comes in a multitude of expressions. Hebrews 11:1 defines biblical faith as “...the assurance of things hoped for, the conviction of things not seen. For by it the men of old gained approval.” There is only one, divinely inspired faith however, and it is systematically revealed in the Bible—>which, of course, is founded upon the Torah. This would be the apostolic faith of the early Nazarene Israelites before it became mixed with religious interventions. Concerning the Torah—though a part of it has been suspended until the post-tribulation Millennium period of peace and prosperity (Ezek. 40-46), it remains valid and applicable for today and is the spiritual foundation of the Holy Bible. Further, the Torah’s instructions and principles are reiterated throughout the divinely inspired Scriptures–from Genesis through the Revelation. Messiah Yeshua followed the Torah’s instructions flawlessly.

Yahweh’s sanctioned faith has been set forth and modeled by the early Nazarene believers. And this pristine truth is the holy template for Spirit-born, faith-oriented followers of Messiah Yeshua to emulate. It provides the means of achieving victory over the (a) infernal works of spiritual darkness and the (b) manifold oppressions spawned by the vain, anti-Messianic systems of the world “that lies in the power of the evil one” (1 John 5:19). It is by believing and acting upon the assurances of Scripture that the followers of Messiah conquer the dark works of spiritual wickedness that reign in the earth and afflict our lives–to a greater or lesser degree. Prayer, faith, and conformance with Yahweh’s sacred instructions are the keys to overcoming the world’s corruption ad remaining clean and set apart. As you probably know--the victory over the satanic evil pervading the planet has already been won and secured by Yeshua’s His atonement, shed blood, death and resurrection. We will look at the three ways this works for us, His followers. John 3:18: “Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already, because they have not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.” Yahweh did not send His Son to condemn the world, but to save it–that is, the people of it that turn to trust in Him. But those who choose to not accept salvation in His name are considered condemned, unless they repent and come to Him. John 3:16, and verse 36 especially. [1] We are saved by grace through faith in the Messiah. Ephesians 2:8-9. Yahweh’s love and care for His saints is also demonstrated by this simple promise:: “And whatever you ask in prayer, you will receive” (Mt. 21:22). Consider these words as meant for you, personally.

Now let’s review the four key realities to which believers—you and I included of course, must adjust in order to develop a life of victory over sin, worldliness, lust, spiritual wickedness and any other long standing nemesis. First, we must understand the victory of our resurrected Messiah and Savior, Yeshua -- what it is and how it applies to and invigorates common disciples of today. Secondly, as mentioned, the saints must become better informed of the doctrinal errors of institutionalized, Torah-less Christianity, and the (1) conflicting diversity of Scripture interpretation, (2) skewed teaching, and (3) conflicting orthodoxy it has produced. [By the way, I am not picking on or judging Christendom. The widely spread, varied religious organization has done much good in presenting the Gospel to the nations. I am, however, pointing out the stumbling blocks that need to be removed. Do you think they should be kept in place??] In any case, the need to either (a) recalibrate and make doctrinal corrections within the Body of Messiah’s Saints or (b) crossover all the way to the Torah based, apostolic Nazarene faith—is apparent and presents a fork in the road, so to speak. The stated options are real alternatives to restoration. Such a transition would remove false notions and restore truth by which saints could enhance prophetic vision and spiritual power. By the grace of our eternal Elohim, I'm happy to remind you that appropriate faith calibrations are underway as you read. A widespread awakening to the centrality of the Torah is still required to serve as the core of an enduring revival that’s needed to rise and spread now. Nevertheless, the doctrinal mix and accompanying uncertainty of the nominal, western Ecclesia has never been purged and, as a whole, still suffers from diverse and inconsistent Bible interpretation and varied contradicting beliefs. Thirdly, reformers must repent of worldliness, rise up and leave behind the corrupted character and evil spirit of Babylon, so called for valid reasons, which pervades all the nations of earth and perverts their secular and spiritual institutions. Yeshua’s followers, those who aspire to discipleship, must return to the ancient paths spoken of in Jeremiah 6:16. Is it not written? “I heard another voice from heaven, saying, ‘Come out of her my people, so that you will not participate in her sins and receive of her plagues, for her sins have piled up as high as heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities” (Rev. 18:4). Believers are Spirit-born and elevated for separation from the world's debauched systems in order to worship and serve the eternal Elohim of Israel, Yahweh. Fourthly, followers of the Good Shepherd should commit to “keeping the Torah-based faith,” a sacred standard of life and faith that was modeled by the original apostolic Nazarene Israelites. To adhere to the Father’s sacred instructions—all that are known, applicable, and doable, is why the saints are covenanted with the Messiah. Such was the commitment of Paul, all the apostles, and the early Book-of-Acts, set-apart disciples as well. In the sight of Yahweh there is a clear distinction between the holy and the unholy; between the clean and the unclean. Holiness—the state of being separated from that which is unclean, is very important to residing in a state of victory and maintaining friendship-fellowship with our Good Shepherd. Do not underestimate His expectation, especially since His saints have been spiritually reborn for this esteemed Royal Priesthood status and role. Regarding this, the apostle wrote: “You were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ (Yeshua Ha Mashiach) and by the Spirit of our God” (1 Cor. 6:11). What do you think, friends? How would you describe your state of sanctification?

First of the Four Realities –- The Means of Victory

It is written: “But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ (Yeshua Ha Mashiach)” (1 Cor. 15:57).

1. Faith in the Messiah, our Savior and Good Shepherd, unites us with Him and provides for us a share, so to speak, in His victory. Living a successful life of “overcoming” persuasive temptations and spiritual wickedness is expected of the Spirit-led disciples of the Savior. Such a life unfolds with our dependence on His promises and compliance with His truth. Revelation 2 and 3. Yeshua, the Son of God (Mark 1:1) has overcome the world in three ways which we list below. So be confident. Faith and victory are within reach for you and me too, since we true disciples—students who are happy walking in His ways and and conforming daily to His words. Yes, consistent effort is necessary for such an endeavor, but it will prove to be very profitable to us and others, and will glorify Yeshua also! [1] So, shall we provide more room in our lives for His blessing. Absolutely!

A. Messiah Yeshua has grappled with and put to open shame the sinful element of the world–that of self will and opposition to the eternal Creator, Yahweh. This was accomplished by His sinless life, sacrificial death, burial, resurrection from the grave, and ascension to the Father. He contended with and defeated the evil one–Satan and thus his dark kingdom of rulers, principalities, dominions, and thrones–which speak of the rank and file of innumerable sentient spirit entities. By His atonement and resurrection He conquered death and took away–or cancelled, the believers’ debt due to sin (lawbreaking) by “nailing it to the cross.” (Col. 2:14)! It is not written: “The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law; but thanks be to God [Yahweh] who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ [Yeshua HaMashiach] (1 Cor. 15:54-55)

B. By the Son’s atoning death the prince of this world system was cast out. Satan is defeated. Though he, his ranks and files of fallen angelic spirits, and the myriads of demonic creatures—all of which are already condemned to the Lake of Fire (Revelation 20:10, 14, and 15)—can still wage an anti-Messiah, limited spiritual warfare. Nevertheless, true Spirit-born believers are liberated and spiritually empowered to “wrestle against” spiritual wickedness in all its forms and in doing so partake of Yeshua’s great victory. Ephesians 6:10-18. Remember, what He said to His disciples in Luke 10:19 is applicable to us today. “Behold, I have given you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall hurt [overcome] you.”

C. And by continual intercession our eternal High Priest secures the same victory to all His followers, time and again–- even for all who hear His voice (instructions) and follow Him. John 3:36; 10:4. Remember always, Yeshua is the eternal High Priest of the believers’ discipleship. “ The suffering servant, the Messiah and the promise of the Holy Spirit were prophesied to Israel in the shadows and types revealed in the Old Covenant, the Tanakh…but they were not clearly understood before Yeshua incarnated on earth and made the New Covenant with and through His own Holy Blood on the cross. Through Him, the ‘seed’ of Abraham, the Gentiles and ‘Lost Tribes’ have also been called and offered the Marriage Cup of Communion and oneness with HaShem–YHWH, through the promise of the indwelling Holy Spirit.” [3b]

2. Also, by use of His name, Yeshua [Jesus], and declaring His truth boldly as did our Messiah in the wilderness, the dark powers and spiritual wickedness of the world are confronted and bested. It is written: “But thanks be to God! He gives us victory through our Lord Jesus Christ” (1 Cor. 15:55-57). Therefore I charge you, beloved of Yeshua the soon-coming King of Glory — “Be strong in the LORD and in the power of His might” (Ephesians 6:10). This verse urges His contender’s-for-truth to be prepared for conflict, suit up in the armor, and stand strongly against the schemes and spirits of wickedness…and prevail.

3. Jesus is the eternal Son of Yahweh our Elohim, and hence He is first in all things. Indeed, to start with we mention that He is first in the Holy Scriptures, being present in the first word of the first book of the Torah–Beresheit. It means “in the beginning.” But did you know that Yeshua is the resheit of beresheit! Resheit means first fruits, beginnings, source, firstly, best, and inception. All these interpretations of the word resheit point to the living Torah, Yeshua! He is thus cited first — in the first verse of the first page of the first book of the Tanakh. Hence, He holds first place in the Bible itself. Beresheit. Further, Yeshua is revealed in every one of the 66 books of the Bible. And be sure of this truth–our crucified and resurrected Savior wants to occupy first place in the heart of every saint as well. Second place or beyond is absolutely unacceptable, fit only for the lukewarm.

4. True faith, once the word of life is accepted by a convert, is infused into the new saint’s soul by divine enlightenment from Spirit of Elohim. It is reinforced with love and righteousness, and can become an active force in the life of the newborn follower of Yeshua. Further, faith grows strong in the soul of the disciples of Messiah who conform to His truth, believe the promises and are thereby blessed. In this way faith, fostered by love, grows increasingly active especially as the believers begins to find himself or herself winning spiritual challenges and chasing away the devil’s bullies. It is written: “ So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead” (James 2:17). Let’s keep our faith well exercised and strong, dear readers. Act upon the Word!

5. The victory over the world’s sinfulness (culminating in the resurrection unto life everlasting)) is attained only by Spirit-born believers in Messiah Yeshua, those who have crossed over from the dark kingdom of Satan and have been translated into the Kingdom of Yahweh’s dear Son. He is our Redeemer who rescued us who believe. He has purchased our freedom by His shed blood, and has forgiven our sins. Col. 1:13-14. The choice to not believe and refuse to obey His truth leads the unrepentant to condemnation. John 3:36 makes that point clear. [1A]

Remember, brethren: “The battles of life transcend the physical realm and you cannot engage your spiritual enemies in a fight without adequate spiritual empowerment. When you have the full assurance of faith that your God is beside you [going with you] and supporting all your moves, you can boldly confront the issues of your life with faith. ‘For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in the high places’ (Ephesians 6:12). [6B] Make His strong right hand of power be your companion.

Part 3

In Post Two Contender’s Voice briefly commented on the reality of the victory of Messiah Yeshua over–the (a) sinful aspect of the world, (b) the rulers, powers, and global forces of spiritual darkness, and (c) the sentient spiritual wickedness of the heavenly places. Further, the post shared how, by our faith and covenant with Him, sanctified Spirit-born believers share in His victory and authority through the declaration of His name and the Word of God. In this way the saints are well able to (1) resist and defeat the prominent, demonic forces that energize lawlessness and afflict the minds of biblically undisciplined people. Also in this way, believers can (2) stand firm in the original Torah-rooted, apostolic faith–the New Covenant template of true discipleship “once entrusted” to the Nazarene Israelites, and thereby (3) gain the victory according to the precious promises embedded in Scriptures. Now, in Post Three, we will consider the second reality–the problem of institutional Christianity being a fragmented, Torah-less faith. This is indeed a shortcoming bearing existential ramifications for the future of honest followers of Yeshua, the hope of an enduring revival, even our wobbling nation. Next, with Post Four, we will consider the third reality– the iniquitous spirit of Babylon under which our needy nation abides and suffers. And finally, in the last section, Post Five--we will look to Paul the apostle and consider the important fourth reality–the good fight of faith. He models the lifestyle commitment which the saints must emulate for them/us to stand upright in Yahweh’s sacred truth, cultivate a friendship-fellowship with the Messiah, experience the Holy Spirit’s power, and mature in Yeshua’s likeness. Such is the path toward the resurrection of the just and eternal life! See Daniel 12:2; John 5:28-29; Philippians 3:10-11. What’s more, in Post Five we will share what Yahweh Himself thinks of His Torah. And you, dear reader, will find this fascinating and inspirational. Now, go forward with me.

Second Reality –- The Confusion of Christianity.

It is written: “The Word is near you…the Word of faith we are proclaiming…” (Romans 10:8).

1. By the verse posted above, we notice Paul is declaring that the unflawed Word of God, which was taught by the Savior and His apostles to the Nazarene believers, was the unflawed message of salvation faith which the early Church/Ecclesia proclaimed. It was without error, did not need correction, was easily accessible, not difficult to understand...and readily available. We are reminded that salvation is proclaimed by the inspiration of faith in the heart and the proclamation of the mouth. So, Paul’s record is true. Divine truth was openly proclaimed, and not hidden away or out of reach. However, history reveals that the word of Yahweh, once esteemed by the entire apostolic Ecclesia, did not remain unchallenged. With the inclusion of people from the nations entering the Hebraic-Jewish Ecclesia, and the errant teachers that brought their false doctrines and practices with them into the Nazarene assemblies--doctrinal conflation began to occur and grow, causing much uncertainty and division among the congregants. By the second century the true Hebraic doctrines and customs became less regarded and were gradually pushed away as foreign religious doctrines and practices were absorbed. Thus, many believers became deceived and fell away from the pristine, blessed Nazarene faith. These confused people, having no faith assembly to attend, resorted to the only alternative--the hybrid false church that had grown and become engrained in Rome’s polytheistic culture. By the fourth century the original Israelite Nazarene faith gave up its Hebraic-Jewish standards and customs by Roman decree. The religious hybrid offspring, which grew out from Antioch, became known as Christian—no longer Hebraic. The mixed faith had grown and accommodated worldly spiritual intrusions with the Gospel. Hence it was endorsed by the Emperor Constantine. In time, Sunday replaced Saturday as the new but unholy Sabbath. The emergent, Torah-less universal Ecclesia of the nations was endorsed by Rome and came under the authority of a politically empowered papacy and took on the designation-Catholic, which means “Universal.” The Sabbath, the Moedim, the Torah, and other Hebraic-Jewish practices once revered were rejected from this national religion’s eclectic orthodoxy. Transferred into the vacated space were unholy pagan customs, a false Sabbath, statutes and idols, altered calendar times and seasons, and a Romanized Jesus—all of which bore witness to the demise of the original Nazarene Israelite faith. Such was the wretched work undergirded and energized by the ever-present, pernicious and invasive—evil spiritual forces of Babylon.

2. Be sure of this, dear friend— victorious living and spiritual development for all believers are founded upon obedience to the Word of Elohim–all biblical truth which is known, applicable, and doable. Conformance to true, unadulterated Biblical faith is essential for holiness and righteous living to thrive. Such are essential to salvation faith and overcoming the sinful element of the world. Lamentably, these blessed attributes of true discipleship are continually assailed, even ignored, and shelved, in westernized religion. Such is the result of ever-spreading doctrinal disagreements and diversified doctrines and contradictory beliefs of the multitude of denominations, fellowships, assemblies, and other various groups. Yes, the divine writings are ridiculed and impugned, a situation further exacerbated by the great variety of conflicting Bible versions and verse interpretations. The negative effect is profound. For instance, recently a report from the Prophetic News Watch stated that 76% of church-going Christians contest the origin and inerrancy of the Scriptures. That kind of faith cannot support the saints’ spiritual warfare or properly orchestrate a stable, unassailable cultural restoration.

3. He/she who rejects Messiah and His words is helpless against the temptations and trials wrought by evil forces on earth and subject to judgment and damnation. The true faith of the Nazarene Israelites was entrusted to the early apostolic saints to be followed and handed down in its pristine form to upcoming generations. See Deuteronomy 6:5-8. The true Sabbath-keeping New Covenant faith was Messiah centric, Torah-rooted, Spirit-friendly, and focused on discipleship. There was no need for new doctrines, faith practices, or fellowship with pagan beliefs. Therefore, if you are born again, you are a servant of the Messiah and your duty is to contend for, guard and defend the original faith…His holy faith! His unadulterated faith! From its foundation we can live and overcome. What do you think, friend? See Jude 1:3; Lk. 18:8.

Learn: Study the Scriptures on your own. A weekly sermon is often formed according to the beliefs of the minster. Some will be correct, but some will likely not be correct. Look for the Holy Spirit to teach you by awakening your senses to discern His instructions and providing enlightenment and understanding. And Let Scripture interpret Scripture. Effort is necessary. The life of a disciple of Messiah Yeshua is demanding, however it is also satisfying and rewarding. Keep in mind that living according to His words is the pathway of biblical faith that will take you to the “resurrection of the righteous” (Luke 14:14) and the “crown of life” (James 1:120. Thus, remember always what has been written by Apostle Paul: “I can do all things through the Messiah who strengthens me” (Philippians 4:13). Yahweh will also—day and night-strengthen you and me as well, blessed reader. We have good reason to rejoice and be glad!
