Part Four

1. It is written: “Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul” (Jer. 50:8-20; 2 Cor. 18:3; 2 Cor. 6:17).

Ancient Babylon was once a compelling, influential city and capital of the powerful, imperialistic Babylonian empire of Mesopotamia. It was located on the Euphrates River in what is modern day Iraq. The civilization showed impressive architectural prowess, possessed great wealth, celebrated idolatrous religions, practiced sacrificial idolatry, and was protected by a powerful, aggressive military force. Its empirical history ranges from 1894 BCE to 539 BCE. It was a pagan-centered metropolis that worshipped many false gods including: Maduk , who was believed to be the creator of humanity. And there were Istar, Shamash, Ea, Tiamat and Enil, who was thought to live in the sky. These are examples of false deities found in Babylon’s pantheon. Also, temple statues were erected in prominent parts of the great city, and they were considered the personification of their gods. The empire had a reputation for its cruel subjugation of other nations, and displayed no distinction between morality or immorality. [Of course, they had no Torah.]. Babylon lacked gracious cultural qualities, and warfare principles-of-decency were not known or practiced during that period. The empire was entirely corrupted and controlled by satanic forces, even from its beginning as a minor city-state under the Amorite Dynasty. It gained prominence and expanded to dominate the Middle East and Asia Minor region. Only what was beneficial for the Empire and extended its power base was promoted, not the ideals of life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness of which we Americans are familiar. There was no Babylonian Dream, so to speak. Thus, the empire of Babylon grew and ended up becoming a “tool” of judgment in the hand of Yahweh.

Being without any clear sense of the purpose and peril of the spiritual warfare that engulfs earth’s civilizations and plagues its beleaguered populations, the spiritually obtuse Babylonian empire was exposed and subject to the infernal powers that controlled and oppressed it. Such is the intent of the destructive spiritual wickedness that come and go from their abode is the heavenlies, so called. The empire existed in a spiritually dull state-of-mind, unaware of the hellish influence (a) shaping its character, (b) planning its eventual doom, and hence (c) keeping the marked empire beyond the reach of correction but under satanic control. Thus, today the name Babylon has come to symbolize unconscionable wickedness, gross immorality, disregard for human liberty, and ungodly power. The lamentable spiritual condition has existed throughout mankind’s earthly dimension as it lies under Babylon’s lawless, pitiless spirit. The USA and the nation’s people at large, are not exempt from this accursed overlay but have become subject to this darkness…perhaps even more-so that many other countries.

In 587 BCE, during its time of unchallenged power, Babylon invaded Judah–the Southern Kingdom of Israel. The invading forces destroyed Jerusalem, razed the holy Temple, confiscated the nation's riches and artifacts as a spoil, and took the captured Israelites into exile. Babylon thus became a tool of judgment used by Yahweh to discipline Judah for its brazen lawbreaking and idolatry. Decades later the Neo-Babylonian Empire–with Babylon still its capital, was conquered by the Persian Empire in 539 BCE. Everything associated with the conquered nation had been subjected to spiritual wickedness and opposed to righteousness. Therefore, Mystery Babylon is a title that applies to those systems that become affected and driven by the pernicious, infernal spirit that captivated, dominated, corrupted, and ended up destroying Babylon itself. It remains a death spell that be-fouls entire societies and bonds people to demonic powers that will take unrepentant souls downward to the horrifying chambers of hell to await the final judgment and the Lake of Fire. Matt. 10:28, 2 Thess. 1:9, Revelation 19:20, 20:10, 20:14-15, and 21:8. Babylon’s evil effect emanated from idolatry, amorality, and the corrupt social values enforced by system of governance that was seated upon idolatry, fornication, cruelty, and demonized evil rulers. Its sins are connected to paganism, fornication, and assorted abominations and thus the name is appropriate. Babylon means confusion, a fitting moniker for something that promotes evil and rebellion. In 539 BCE ancient Babylon was conquered by the Persians under Cyrus the Great. The Empire fell but its spirit of corruption, lust for materialism, and opposition to the truth of the true God spread across the known world. The point is this: Nothing has changed. You and I, along with our nation and its institutions and enterprises, are under a satanic spell—forces that undergirded Babylon, and we must come out from under it. Post Four gives us the directions out!!

Nevertheless, many people today simply consider Babylon as a bygone relic of history. They do not realize that the dark spirit that reigned over that ancient unholy kingdom has also dominated Persia, Mongolia, Greece, and Rome. It continues to overlay and befoul nations today—our country included as I have mentioned. Yet, it is usually remembered as the sprawling capital city of Mesopotamia that dominated the middle east but is of no consequence today.

2. Another voice came out from heaven, saying, “Come out from her, my people, so that you will not participate in her sins and receive of her plagues, for her sins have piled up high as heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities” (Rev. 18:4).

Babylon’s legacy exists as Mystery Babylon

Babylon, the wicked and brutal nation, was given over to demonic forces, and hence reposed under the long-lasting evil persuasions of the sentient spiritual wickedness of the heavens. The ruling spirits of Babylon deceived and enlisted generations of rulers to satisfy their psychotic instincts and pursue worldly power, accumulate wealth, embrace moral corruption, and bow to demonic spirituality. Keep in mind—spiritual entities feed off the miseries, failures, lusts and addictions, and the sinfulness of deceived and conflicted humanity. In the Book of Revelation it is depicted as Babylon the Great-- a force of global corruption and the exploitation of God’s truth. As it once was, so it is today. Consider: “What has been will be again, what has been done will be done again; there is nothing new under the sun” (Eccl. 1:9). America, as did Persia, Greece, and Rome along with the many nations on earth, exists under this oppressive dark spiritual weight of old Babylon. So does our traditional religion—Christianity. And you and me, too.

The ancient paths depicted in the Torah, and viable Hebrew customs and traditions delivered to believers by YHWH, are the paths of which Jeremiah spoke. (Jeremiah 6:16.) America’s traditional religion has turned from these paths of pure, fundamental Nazarene truth to distortions. Over the centuries they were jettisoned or pre-empted in favor of worldly teachings and customs, philosophies bereft of existential value, and lifeless pagan doctrines that vitiated the Ecclesia's spiritual integrity and power. Simply—Christendom does not honor the complete Word of God. It is therefore spiritually incomplete, and in its present form cannot be used to turn back the encroaching evil rising in this hour and sustain an enduring whole-truth revolution–the revival that is most fit for this transhumanist laden period. Something more than another “refreshing move” is required. A return to living our lives upon the ancient paths of YHWH’s Torah instructions comprises our only hope for overcoming the present darkness and glorifying Yeshua. This the work of the spirit of the Babylon legacy. It embodies hopelessness, offers nothing but oppression, monotony modeling the tedious cycle of life leading to death and judgment. The Kingdom of God on the other hand offers life eternal and sublime fellowship with the Most Hight God of Israel. How sweet that is for us, dear reader!

Though the dominant empire no longer exists, its powerful and infernal spiritual ethos is working in every modern nation, molding and controlling their spiritual, political, and financial institutions, and fanatically pursuing the persecution of Yeshua’s followers in every country. While doing so it promotes anti-Torah false religions, mingles the Gospel with human ideas and traditions, and divides believers into countless conflicting groups. Babylon’s evil influence is actually a highly toxic plague of lawlessness that captivates and bewilders the souls of multitudes. Do you believe earth’s varied cultures have been spiritually and morally misshaped by ancient Babylon’s satanic legacy? How has this spiritual pathology affected your family, or you personally, dear saint?

Conclusion: Teshuvah time has arrived, for sure!!! Do you not think, blessed friend, that it is time for Yeshua’s “faith contenders” to declare the Torah is still alive and walk out the Holy Scriptures before a nation under duress. The forces of Babylon normalize sin, oppress government, encourage unholy entertainment, intoxicate nations with sensuality, expand dominations, and stifle religious freedom. It has even (a) shaped the still controls the papacy, (b) keeps Christianity Torah-less and bonded to Sunday as the Sabbath, and (c) is the spiritual component undergirding the collapse of America’s stability. Further, as you know, it is also behind the NWO and AI blueprint for a new age societies post-human epoch.

Turn Away!

Consider Apostle Paul’s clear warning. “For the time will come when people will not endure sound doctrine, but have itching ears they will heap up teachers to fit their own desires, and they will turn away from listening to the truth and wander off to myths” (2 Timothy 4:3-4). Has this lawless time arrived? Yes, without a doubt! The condition of our nation bears witness. Many churchgoers today have become disinterested in the teaching of the full, unadulterated Word of God. Frankly, the hellish spirit of Mystery Babylon has subtly persuaded them—in the same amiable and convincing way the lying satanic entity of Genesis 3:1-7 tempted and deceived Eve and Adam in Eden. The soft and amiable tones of the foul spirit entity convinced the couple to embrace only what pleases and intrigues them. There are numerous and varied new-age, spiritual beliefs and practices rising today that whisper the same lies. The proffered fascinations and adventurisms lure unbelievers and believers alike, and promise revelation and exciting experiences that will enlighten and transform their souls. Lies! Of course, the promoters proclaim a new spiritual age is unfolding and that biblical faith and practice must shift to keep in step with the so-called, new things. And as false teachers of old, modern wolves craft Scripture to validate their new revelations none of which are founded in the Gospel message. Such un-biblical teaching stirring popular interests include, but are not limited to: (a) Christian political dominionism--a politically based ideology, (b) self-actualization and personal esteem—Abraham Maslow’s theory of self-fulfillment, (c) angelic visitation, (d) the religion of scientism, (e) transhumanism—the re-boot blueprint for science-based human evolution, (f) mysticism and heightened carnal consciousness, (g) Kabbalism—a mystic-oriented pursuit of many celebrities, (h) astral projection—dangerous journeys into the first and second heavens, (i) the ever-present lure of astrology with its resonant unholy vibe carrying the curse of a fallen universe, (j) exalting nature—global warming et al, and (l) many other fascinations the enemy uses to draw Yahweh’s people away from common sense…and the pure, dependable prophetic Word of God, Messiah Yeshua, and His narrow-road journey to eternal life. Followers may be sincere in their quest to experience Yahweh in greater measure, but by leaving behind the clear emphasis of the words of the Messiah, that have already been given to us and that run from Genesis through Revelation, is foolish. The alternative is to abide in the multiplied, cunning deceptions of the father-of-lies and partake of their ending—judgment and the sulfur lake. Sanctification—or holiness, is the only condition sanctioned by the Almighty… not fantasies and shady new age spiritual pursuits.

Displace the spirit of Mystery Babylon and Replace the Ancient Foundations!

Lawlessness reigns throughout the land. It’s the real . This explains why the (1) Torah, (2) the Holy Spirit’s un-restricted, powerful ministry, (3) the sanctification of the saints—holiness, and (4) the uncompromised devotion to Messiah Yeshua with obedience to all His instructions--must be restored to create needed new wineskins for the Ecclesia. A “whole-truth recovery revival” is that which the declining Church system needs today, for nothing less will accomplish and support the national and religious restoration that is sorely needed. It would renew “life truth” for ourselves as believers, and for the foundation supporting an enduring spiritual and secular restoration. In other words, recovering and adhering to the original apostolic Nazarene faith is the necessary step, or platform, to regaining and sustaining pure worship and holy living pleasing the Yahweh. This is blessed assurance for each of us who are aspiring contenders for our Abba’s sacred truth. Only unadulterated Torah-rooted truth presents and nourishes the essentials and outgrowth of spiritual salvation: “If you declare with your mouth, Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved. For it is with your heart that you believe and are justified, and it is with your mouth that you profess your faith and are saved” (Romans 10:9-10).

Destiny

“Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins, and raise up the age-old foundations…” (Isaiah 58:12). The prophet was speaking to Judah to encourage the people concerning the desire of YHWH to restore the Jewish people to their former glorious estate. But the words have application to us also. Today’s Spirit-born saints are covenanted as redeemed Israel, are thus included in the covenants and promises, and are summoned by the Holy Spirit to participate in His prophetic purpose for this hour. Generations need to be reached with the unadulterated Gospel. His anointed contenders for whole truth ministry will function in restoring the ancient foundations of Torah instructions to converts, believers, and the generations to come. This is a glorious calling, isn’t it?

Mystery Babylon will come to an inglorious end. So will its patrons.

3. Although as a spiritual force, spiritual Babylon is going to remain a while longer. But in time it will fall. As it is written: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, she who has made all the nations drink of the wine of the passion of her immorality” (Rev. 14:8). Many will rejoice on that day

Yes, the Spirit of Mystery Babylon presents itself in many evil forms. [1] Yet it is written: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! He [it] has become a dwelling place of demons and a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison for every unclean and hateful bird. For all the nations have drunk of the wine of her immorality, and the kings of the earth have committed acts of immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth have become rich by the wealth of her sensuality” (Rev. 18:2).

Mystery Babylon will fall. Therefore, Contender’s Voice encourages each reader, myself included, to make the best of our time on earth. It is written: “But we have renounced the hidden things of dishonor, not by acting craftily, not by falsifying the word of God, but by making the truth manifest, commending ourselves to every person’s conscience in the sight of God” (2 Cor. 4:2).

Conclusion: We must abandon the systems of the world, forsake falsehood and all wickedness, and return to the clear, unadulterated instruction of Scripture that have been shelved by western Christian ministries in favor of faulty spiritual pursuits and be finally be sanctified! His commandment, and His warning, for this hour is written: “Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul” (Jer. 50:8-20; 2 Cor. 18:3; 2 Cor. 6:17).

Concluding points for us to grasp and from which to prosper: First. Babylon will fall completely. It has nothing of value to offer. Only death. Second. Come fully away completely from its corrupted worldly systems and promotions. Third. Abide faithfully—even unswervingly, in Yeshua’s Kingdom truth. Fourth. Develop a strong prayer life and and intimate fellowship with the Messiah by the communion of the Spirit. There’s nothing hard with such commitments, only blessings of the Father. Here is your promise, blessed disciple: “Tell the righteous it will be well with them [ YOU and me, dear reader], for they will enjoy the fruit of their deeds” (Isaiah 3:10).

Post Five concludes our Victory of Faith presentation. The “Good Fight of Faith” is the next blog’s title. Paul is featured and the values of the Torah are set forth also. Be sure to look for it. It should be an encouragement for all of us as His overcomers...who are walking on the Torah’s narrow road to transformation and, at its terminus–eternal life in the glory of Yahweh and His divine Son, Yeshua. Amen. Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom

So let’s go forward and prayerfully consider this amazing existential occurrence.

The Tower of Babel was a colossal construction project built around 4,200 years ago, or about 2234 BC. That would be 100 years after the Noahic Flood but before the rise of early civilizations such as Egypt and Greece. The Tower was constructed by the people of lower Mesopotamia who rejected the Creator who had brought Noah and His family safely through the global waters and into an entirely new era. Anyway, the people wanted to be associated with the feat of building a great monument. The huge tower that was central in the surrounding city is said to also have had a religious purpose and a priestcraft over-seeing the tower project. The religious leaders designed the great Tower of Babel to be conspicuously high and thus able to connect with the spiritual vibe of the angelic spirits of the heavens and attract their attention. Its rise and fall are featured in Genesis, as we know. See Genesis 11. The Tower was, in fact, a diabolical work planned and overseen by ambitious, occult religionists intending to create a spiritual portal to the supranatural reality and denizens of the second heaven. However, as we know, the earthlings of that period never achieved their unsanctified goal. They failed to consider the past and thus did not realize their vision was not new or original…nor likely to succeed. The builders sought to create a structure designed to reproduce the profoundly wicked, spiritual condition that had existed on earth earlier, before the flood occurred and the Noahic Covenant was established. But God, knowing well the nature of the sentient hellish forces undergirding the infernal enterprise, curtailed its progress and brought the tower down, scattered the builders, and ended the project altogether. This providential action prevented another invasion of pre-flood spiritual wickedness from taking form and inundating the planet at it had in the era of the hybrid, Nephilim giants centuries earlier. Still, things have a habit of reoccurring in life. In fact, Scripture presents this cycle-of-life that occurs on earth by declaring that whatever once was, will be again. It is written: “Vanity of vanities! All is vanity…That which has been will be, and that which has been done is that which will be done…there is nothing new under the sun” (Ecclesiastes 1:1 and 9). This Scripture would pertain to the Genesis 1:1 epochs as well as to the eras that have followed Genesis 1:2. Conclusion: A gateway Tower—another one possessing the same ethos of the original Tower of Babel, is rising. In fact, two Towers are rising and they will present a clear faith challenge to the people of earth. What do you think about that, dear reader? Do you live by worldly preferences or biblical convictions, or maybe by a mixture of both as do many Christ confessors? The time ahead will reveal the nature and quality of our standards.

What should the reader surmise from the Scripture posted above? It declares: “All is vanity.” The statement is reinforced in verse 14 which states: “I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit….” It avers that if anyone’s life--regardless of its achievements, prosperity, or status, is not centered upon the eternal Elohim, His prophetic purpose, and love-based commandments, that life is a futile vapor, bereft of purpose, and ultimately meaningless. Remember what is written: “Fear God and keep His commandments for this is the whole duty of man” (Ecclesiastes 12:13). That means everyone is summoned to reverence the Almighty and conform to His blessed instructions. There is no mincing of words here. No equivocation at all. The blunt scripture verse may sound dictatorial but it is actually a compassionate awakening call for us, a reveille so to speak, and thus a presentation of pure, life giving truth. Apart from Yahweh and faith in His eternal Son Yeshua, earthly life offers no lasting satisfaction or blessed eternity. None at all. It is written: “Whosoever believes in Him shall not perish.” Re-read John 3:16 and especially verse 36, carefully.

Humans have a natural interest for change. Consequently, in varied ways we spend our lives passing from one sort of lifestyle, quest, or worldly adventure to another. But Scripture has just informed us that there are no novelties or new things in, under, or above the natural world--or with its social systems or human affairs. That means there are no more original types of activities, ambitions, or purposes at work on earth than there were in the past. Nothing in the material world is new, only repetitive. Throughout history people have possessed the same types of desires and ambitions as before, only in different forms and goals. Still, current human endeavors for change offer no greater satisfaction than that which has preceded them. We will see that genuine newness is possible but only such that is connected to the spiritual realm.

Consider this verse written by Apostle Paul, a scholar of the Torah, Prophets, and Writings: “Therefore, if anyone is in Christ (that is, born of the Spirit), he is a new creation; old things are passed away; behold, all things have become new” (2 Corinthians 5:17). Inner transformation of mankind’s spirit and soul, which is the most vigorously sought after transcendental experience of countless people, is usually pursued through chasing assorted ideologies, endless philosophies, new age faith and practices, esoteric religions and dreams, and other earthly bobbles and trinkets. However the Scripture informs us of this key truth: Inner transformation and enduring newness of spirit and soul is possible only by the Spirit of Elohim. These worldly avenues may produce something nominally helpful for the ardent seeker but in the end they will never give rise to anything new or original. That which is distinctly new and eternally beneficent is set forth only by the Holy Spirit through faith in the shed blood and resurrection of the Messiah. Hence, Yeshua said: “But seek first the Kingdom of God and His righteousness and all these things will be added to you as well” (Matthew 6:33).

Re-emergence is Taking Place.

So, let’s re-think this inspired statement: “That which has been will be, and that which has been done is that which will be done.” The Ecclesia—I’m addressing modern, westernized Christendom—should pay close attention to the posted verse! That Scripture speaks of a cyclical re-emergence of things past, whether good or bad, rising in the earth. Today we are looking at the phenomenon of re-emergence taking place right under our noses. This refers to the simultaneous reappearing of two divided forces, both of which carry existential power and potential for reshaping nations, beneficially or detrimentally. First, there is the Torah rising- the Law of Moses and foundation of all biblical truth. By the grace of the Almighty it is being recovered by ardent, Spirit-led followers of Messiah Yeshua, and the Ecclesia in general. The restoration of the Torah is monumental. It serves as the standard for Kingdom of God living and thereby has application to all nations. The sacred Torah Tower is composed of the blessed laws, precepts, judgments, ordinances , and instructions of Yahweh. To honor them is an expression of salvation faith and real love for God and man. The Torah offers freedom and promotes love. Secondly, there is the tower of Mystery Babylon rising, which embodies the same evil spirituality, occult ethos and satanic ambitions as did the first Tower of Babel. However, this rising techno-tower’s foundation is quantum technology and it is being constructed not with brick and stone but by algorithms and computer coding—the words and programs of frail, spiritually blinded humans. See First Corinthians 2:14, Second Corinthians 4:4, and First John 5:19.

The re-emergent tower is identified as AI. This quantum-based AI Tower points to a post-human epoch featuring genetic engineering, hybrid cloning, varied cloud and digital device applications, and a science-based reboot of human evolution leading to the colonization of the galaxies. That a lot to process. See First Corinthians 2:14; Second Corinthians 4:4, and First John 5:19.

This vision of earth’s New World Order future is undergirded by a dark spiritual but sentient component and is upheld by human Scientism—a modern, transhumanist religion favoring the transformation of humanity and a post human epoch. It was also the vision proclaimed earlier by the psychologist, Timothy Leary, who was a tenured professor of Harvard University. During the seventies this man, guru of sorts, was an ardent advocate of people using the manmade hallucinogenic drug-LSD to perceive new realms of reality, expand self-awareness, and possibly attain cosmic consciousness in preparation for space colonization. To this end, Mr. Leary zealously promoted the necessity of humans creating the means of mankind living in outer space. He claimed human evolution and advancement could only be rebooted in an environment that was far away from the psychic chaos of planet earth. However, the vision of a post human epoch ebbed away from public attention. Yet, transhumanist science, which promotes human DNA engineering, is recycling the notion today—fifty years later. And so we take notice again: “There is nothing new under the sun.” Be sure that, even as cultural normalcy is restored to America and expanding technology introduces beneficial advances into our society—restrictive AI, anti-christ values will be woven into the cultural fabric. This will establish a excessive public surveillance with governmental and religious authoritative oversight to the nations. Consequently, a fundamental choice will be set before the the world’s people: We will be required to openly declare where our individual allegiance lies. Will it be with Yahweh’s unadulterated Torah Truth Tower or with the modern AI Babel Tower. There will be no middle ground. No compromise.

In any case, if this new Babylonian- type tower is not brought down eventually, as was its forebearer, its activity could open a portal into the transcendent sphere of unfriendly inter-dimensional realities. Consider Cern, where in 1989 the World Wide Web was invented. Could its probing of the foundational structure of the universe and its fundamental particles stumble upon an opening into another dimension of creation? Could humanity, even world-focused Christians, handle the overwhelming discovery. After all, earthlings are living under a mounting deluge of conflicting information and influences, and hence we tend to pay homage to numerous religions. Is it not written: “And for this reason God will send them a strong delusion, that they should believe a lie, that they may all be judged who did not believe the truth but had pleasure in unrighteousness” (2 Thess. 2:11). With this truth in mind, friends, I ask you--to which tower of values are you drawn. There are only two roads, only two choices—and now only two towers.

Torah or Tower-You Choose

Choose you alliance, beloved. No more mixing. There is no middle ground. Into which tower are you knitting your life? The eternal Creator has already provided mankind with His sacred, love-based instructions in the Scriptures—all well suited for time and eternity? And upon its truth we must construct our lives and service. So, the Fourth Reality, being necessary for attaining a Victory by Faith—was demonstrated by the Apostle Paul. It is founded upon compliance to the Yahweh’s Torah, all of it that is known, relevant, applicable, and doable. We know portion of the Torah has been suspended since the resurrection of Messiah Yeshua. But the whole will be restored during the Millennium. Ezekiel, chapters 40 through 46.

Thank you for logging on, dear reader. Please continue forward as we view Paul, his ministry of faith, and the blessed attributes of the Torah. Welcome aboard, all ye followers of Messiah Yeshua who hunger and thirst for righteousness and want to be prepared for the appearing of Yeshua. Matthew 5:6. Our Restoration Update is designed for you particularly and it’s exposition should assist your growth in grace by serving you in several helpful ways. For starters, this report encourages faith and energizes hope among common believers by evaluating and reporting on the progress and impact of the historic, Spirit inspired Torah restoration movement. It is a needed, opportune work of the Father’s compassion for restoring the full measure of biblical truth much needed by the Called-Out Assembly. The Dispatch thus presents the prophetic timing, purpose, and anticipated blessed results of the dynamic Torah' recovery phenomenon. This understanding is important because it reassures us that Yahweh is fulfilling His purposes in the earth—for our benefit and His glory. What is more, our Restoration Update charts the progress and reveals the religious impact of the Messianic revolution within the sprawling realm of Christendom. That’s us. Further, Contender’s Restoration Update will also unveil the Torah restoration’s diverse and numerous benefits accessible for needful individual saints first--and then a growing receptive remnant of institutional Christianity. And through a restored Ecclesia Torah truth and standards will leaven the failing American institutions which desperately need to be restored on a solid foundation of divinely inspired, unmixed biblical truth. Witnessing, and experiencing also, Yahweh’s dynamic works of reversing the erosion of biblical faith and immorality that undermines the spiritual integrity of the Ecclesia and stability of the American republic, will inspire zeal among His idle saints and draw forth visionary believers from among us who want to contend for the true faith once for all delivered to the saints. See Jude 1:3. Do you think we Americans need a Torah-centered Truth Revival? The instructions of Yahweh have never been abolished, you know.

Enlarge your Faith and Prophetic vision, dear reader. Learn why believers are returning to the Father’s House and His Instructions--the Torah

There are Restoration Update priorities of which we Christians should be aware. Five are presented this post. First, we should take notice of the vastly different world views of the Torah Restoration movement and that of the AI Transhumanist revolution. “There is a great chasm fixed…” between these two foremost, latter-day era reformations. Consider Luke 16:26. Secondly, may the reader and listener evaluate and judge the incompatible, even conflicting, values and dissimilar visions to which each of these end times cultural movements is inherently committed. Thirdly, our Update expedites discerning the brutality and sadism of humanist beliefs and practices, which are spiritually detrimental to any society, and recover and restore fundamental Torah doctrines and ministry of the Holy Spirit. Both the Torah and full ministry of the Holy Spirit exalt the Son of God, Yeshua, and are absolutely essential is recovering the original pristine, Nazarene Faith. Fourthly, Restoration Update is militant in nature, and encourages the saints to engage in vigorous spiritual warfare using the Scriptures and following the guidance of the Holy Spirit. See John 16:12 through 15. The Spirit of Elohim was promised by Yeshua to be a counselor and guide for the saints. See John 16:8. Such willing cooperation should engender repentance, sanctification, and conformance to the instruction and commandments of Yahweh our Elohim. And fifthly, our militant Restoration Update vigorously contends for the recovery of the original Nazarene, Torah centered faith once known as “The Way.” This goal is absolutely worthy of pursuit and needed by the spiritual weak church system and our country’s uncentered awakening as well! Therefore Contender’s Voice, by way of our Update and study material, contends for the restoration of this unadulterated spiritual model of biblical purity and practice. Thus, today modern Christians, even nominal professors of the Messiah, unschooled converts, and a scattered remnant have four fundemental spiritual needs which this post presents below. Keep in mind, the spiritual warfare underway, even as you read, will resist every step of your growth in grace. But keep going forward! Remember what it is written: “Submit therefore to God. Resist the devil and he will flee from you. Draw near to God and He will draw near to you” (James 4:7). Follow His exhortation and you (and I) will do well.

Need #1. To Recognize the purity and power inherent in the Written Torah.

“Hear, O Israel, the decrees and laws I declare in your hearing today. Learn them, and be sure to follow them” (Deuteronomy 5:1-2).

We understand that it was Moses who wrote the Torah using the ancient Hebrew language. We read in Exodus 24:4 that “Moses wrote down all the words of Yahweh” at Sinai. In Deuteronomy 31:25 it is written: “Moses finished writing the words of this Law in a book until they were complete.” The Torah refers to the first five books of the Bible. In the church they are called the Pentateuch. “The word Hebrew torah does not actually translate to “law.” It is called the “law” because the words of the King of the universe do, indeed, carry the weight of law. However the word torah actually translates to ‘instruction’; In this context it means the bride’s instructions.” The Torah then can be called the constitution of the Kingdom of God that comprises the instructions that anyone wishing to become Yeshua’s bride must practice. Conforming to the Word of Elohim purifies compliant souls. [4B]

The word “Torah” means teach, instruction, or law. It is the first of the three parts of the Tanakh, the Hebrew Bible, which also includes the Writings (ketuvim) and the Prophets (Nevi’im). The Torah consists of (1) Genesis (B’resheit)’ (2) Exodus ((Sh’mot), (3) Leviticus (Vayikra), (4) Numbers (Bamidbar), and (5) Deuteronomy (Dvarim). The Torah is written with allegories, historical narrative, genealogies, poetry, and includes a wide spectrum of social, civil, and religious laws of divine origin. In fact, we are told it contains 613 commandments called mitzvot. They are divided into 365 restrictions or negative commands, such as ”Thou shalt not…”) And there are 248 positive commands such as “Honor thy father and mother…”).

Authorship of the Torah is ascribed to Moses by his reception and recording of divinely imparted words and inspiration. This is supported by the Talmud and textual analysis. Dates vary but many place the time circa 1450 BCE. The Torah establishes the cultural framework for all Israel, but its truth and principles, such as man’s basic duty to love God and one’s neighbor, and the Ten commandments, have universal application. In that sense, the Torah has a valid place in every person's life.

Furthermore, a Sefer Torah is a Torah scroll, a copy that is written under strict conditions on a parchment by a trained scribe. Authorship of the Torah is ascribed to Moses by the process of divinely imparted words and inspiration. This is supported by the Talmud, a collection of Rabbinic teachings, traditions, and oral laws divided into the Mishnah and Gamera. These comprise (b) textual analysis of the Torah and other books of the Old Testament. The sacred Torah however exists as the only divinely inspired text among the commentaries and it has never been abolished, rescinded, or annulled. Hence it remains today the same as yesterday–-the root of all Scripture and prophecy. Love is the fundamental requirement of the Torah. Its promises and instructions reveal the compassionate character of our Creator. (Leviticus 19:18 and Deuteronomy 6:4-5).

Need #2. To Recognize the deviance of Transhumanism’s vision for humanity and Scientism, which holds a disregard for biblical theology and spiritual realities. Both are forces of humanist-based cultural change.

“...the whole world lies in the power of the evil one [god of this age]” (1 John 5:19).

This scripture, written by John the Apostle of Yeshua, indicates that Satan, with the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places, is the major influence on the opinions, world vision, goals , ambitions and crusades of the majority of Earth’s people. However the number would certainly include carnal Christians and casual churchgoers. Though Satan’s domain is limited to unbelievers, many who proclaim the Messiah as their LORD, do not keep his words but live instead by the world's values and abide in unrighteousness. The world’s philosophies, ideologies, education institutions, commerce industries, governments, and much of its communications, lie under infernal influences. When unsanctified people live as if there is no God who rules over His creation, by default they follow the god of this world and willingly adhere to his (Satan’s) unholy, antichrist values, destructive views, wild speculations, corrupt social and economic ideologies, and a plethora of false religions–all of which festoon the nations. They spring forth from foundations of satanic lies and demonic deceptions. Foresight suggests that the whole world will eventually come under the control of a new World Order governed by AI and the codes of frail, easily beguiled humans that have contributed to its reach and expanding influence. Consider what is written: “Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. A man reaps what he sows” (Galatians 6:7). And “...do you not know [realize] that wrongdoers will not inherit the Kingdom of God. Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral…[etc.] (1 Corinthians 6:9-10). Understand–Elohim’s grace leads us to repentance, not license! Your heavenly Father–Abba, has much better things in store for you, blessed disciple!

Need #3. To Recognize false Torah caricatures.

“The one who says, ‘I have come to know Him,’ and does not keep His commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him; but whoever keeps His word, in him the love of God has truly been perfected” (1 John 2:4-5).

Believers do not establish their own standards which invariably are based upon secular, and human notions of love. We perform acts of love for God and man when we obey Yahweh’s Word and walk in His ways. This is the fundamental, underlying principle of worship in Spirit and in Truth of which Yeshua spoke. “Do not think that I came to abolish the law or the prophets; I did not come to abolish but to fulfill“ (Mt. 5:17-20). Though the Messiah plainly stated He came to fulfill the Law [abolishing it would be contrary to His own teachings] the Gnostics undermined the faith of many by teaching that Messiah came to abolish the Law of Moses make it void. These people declared that consenting knowledge alone in Yeshua the Son was all that was required for salvation. “The one who says, ‘I have come to know Him,’ and does not keep His commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him…” This represents the broad road that leads to the sulfur lake–the second death upon which the New Age transhumanist NWO will be constructed and temporarily flourish. But “...whoever keeps His word, in him the love of God has truly been perfected.” This speaks of the narrow road, the Torah and Spirit journey that leads to the resurrection of the righteous. Upon it the Bride of Messiah Yeshua will be found preparing for His glorious appearing. See 1 John 2:4-5. For you it is written: “And ye shall know the truth and the truth shall make you free” (John 8:32). Knowing and fully conforming to the words of truth that come from Yeshua will establish you, friend, in freedom. What does that mean to you?

“...God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who has been given unto us” (Romans 5:5).

The love of Elohim, by way of the blessing of the Holy Spirit dwelling within the regenerated believer, becomes an ethical motivation for his or her life. Such is called agape love that is stirred and perfected as the result of the saint keeping the Father’s sacred Word. And the commitment to pure discipleship, to which we are all summoned by the Messiah Yeshua, develops intimate fellowship. This blessing is the status of harmonious communion with our heavenly Father and His eternal Son, Yeshua. Thus, the way has been opened for saints to experience this wonderful fellowship. Still, I present this question–do you really want to become a friend of Yeshua? He said: “Ye are my friends if ye do whatsoever I command you” (John 15:14 King James Version). This devotion is required! Period! Keep in mind that His instructions begin in the front pages of the Bible and run through Revelation. Numerous perhaps, but all are interrelated, are not burdensome, and are fully founded upon His compassion and love for His people. So be sure, friends–it is clear that love is fundamental, and the overriding attribute and blessing of the Torah. See Leviticus 19:18 and Deuteronomy 6:4 through 7; also Matthew 22:37; Mark 10:20. And for you personally it is written:

Need #4. To Recognize the reality and significance of Spiritual Warfare.

“For our struggle is not against flesh and blood , but against the rulers, against the powers,, against the world forces of this darkness, against the spiritual forces in the heavenly places” (Ephesians 6:12).

Mankind, and the followers of Messiah Yeshua in particular, face “a spiritual conflict with Satan and a host of fallen angels and demonic entities. Such are understood to be sentient evil spirits. These immortal pre-adamite powers of darkness are the spiritual forces of evil who undergird, inspire, and energize the ungodly, oppose God’s will in the earth, and have assaulted and deceived believers of all eras. The truth concerning the vast number of Satanic infernal creatures is that they are highly intelligent and have power to afflict mortals also. It is written: “We know we are of God, and that the whole world lies in the power of the evil one [Satan]” (1 John 5:19).

The satanic host of the heavens constitutes a great multitude organized into a highly systematized empire of evil that is driven by hatred for God Almighty and His mankind—that’s us. It is, in fact, a dark kingdom with well-ordered ranks and files of fallen angels and demon creatures that work havoc and heartache throughout human civilizations. These unredeemable forces are destined for the Lake of Fire. See Revelation 20:10 and 14. Therefore our very-real, ongoing conflict against monumental demonic forces and infernal ideologies must be fought from a spiritual foundation built upon the unadulterated rock of YHWH’s Torah truth…the words of Yeshua. See Matthew 7:24 through 27. The works and hasty promotion of manifold AI technologies are growing and being eagerly accepted by an excited but, undiscerning interconnected public. But unabridged biblical faith and true discipleship honoring the Messiah, on the other hand, are not embraced! Therefore, the Ecclesia–including you and me, dear saint-- simply must turn from its captivation with worldliness and tolerance of lawbreaking, and turn to repentance, unadulterated whole-truth faith, sanctification, and obedience to the leadership of the Spirit. If this does not occur, we will be ill-equipped and unable to displace the powers and energy of darkness. Instead, the Ecclesia—the Called Out Assembly, will fall short of His expectations and our spiritual potential. Indeed, the westernized Church will become–individually and corporately, spiritually moribund and insignificant as His force of righteousness. Of course, this is what the coming Transhumanist era envisions.

Here’s your promise: “For everyone who has been born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world--our faith” (1 John 5:4). This verse speaks of the believers’ relationship with Yahweh through Messiah Yeshua, and the power of faith that is based solely on His Words. Dear reader, you know the true Torah. You have read of Him and His ministry….and are aware of His summons to you to follow Him--not the spirit of this age. Thus, with Him as your Shepherd, you are allied and stabilized, well equipped, and destined to arise as one of your King’s overcomers. How wonderful! Start afresh now. Confront your challenges daily, even boldly, by praying and proclaiming the Word of God in the face of spiritual darkness, as did Yeshua in Matthew, chapter four. In this way your faith will be strengthened and the joy of the LORD will become your steady portion. In other words, adhere as a disciple to the narrow road leading to eternal life and your relationship will grow into a blessed friendship fellowship. Amen.

Torah Attributes are next. Tamid Kadima- Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom

It serves as a metaphor depicting two re-emerging towers that portray spiritual forces re-emerging, and doing so in our unstable constitutional republic. One represents the blessed rise of the Torah among the followers of Yeshua. The other portrays the ascension within our nation of the spirit of Babel, or ancient Babylon, which is captivating and realigning our deteriorating culture. We should not be surprised by the appearance of these opposing spiritual powers, for it is written: “And that which has been done is that which will be done [again]. There is nothing new under the sun” (Ecclesiastes 1:9). In other words: “What goes around, comes around.”

Full restoration of undiminished biblical truth, which is very much needed by western Christendom, is indeed occurring in America -- but not without much demonically generated religious and secular resistance. Nevertheless, the recovery of Torah-based faith realities will occur and become embraced by the many prodigal saints who are repenting, returning to the Father’s house, and contentedly honoring His clear instructions. They aspire to be full-fledged disciples of Yeshua, our Good Shepherd, and nothing less. This widespread Latter Days spiritual confrontation, which is on steroids so to speak, is underway and gaining momentum as you read. The towers are rising! So, with this colossal spiritual conflict going on right under our noses, shouldn’t believers enlist and engage in this militant campaign as we are led by the Holy Spirit! Each of us is summoned and needed in this existential fray. After all, as it is written, He called out: “FollowMe…” (Mark 1:17). This command appears 21 times in Scripture, and each time the word “please” is conspicuously absent. If you are yielded to the Holy Spirit in this hour of global transformation, my friend, you will, by God’s grace—sooner or later, end up facing the Torah. This is important. Considering the challenging and dangerous times that loom ahead and threaten the entire world it would indeed be best for all who claim Yeshua as Savior to truly know Him.

Questions: So, is Yeshua Ha Mashiach, the crucified, buried, and resurrected Son of God–-simply a life coach, a career consultant, or a self-actualization advocate for believers today. Or has western Christianity overlooked that He is indeed something else altogether? So, let’s scrutinize Him again through the lens of the sacred Scriptures and not interpret them by our modern-day, western mindset, but rather be roused as we rediscover who He truly is and start relating to Him biblically.

“In the beginning was the Word, and the Word [the living Torah] was with God, and the Word was God” (John 1:1).

Central Truth: Contender’s Voice is a ministry promoting the Torah-based, solid rock restoration of the Ecclesia’s original foundation of faith. In order to proceed with this vision the builders, so to speak, must first recognize Yeshua as the living Torah--the very embodiment of divine truth. Hence, He is also Adonai, a title of authority that demands respect and honor, and speaks of His divine power and jurisdiction over all creation. Isaiah wrote of Him, “He will swallow up death forever; and the Lord God will wipe away tears from all faces, and the reproach of His people He will take away from the whole earth” (Isaiah 25:8). In other words, He will assert His victory over death and sorrow and we will then rejoice in His Kingdom and exalt Him forever!

He unequivocally commands His followers, whom He loves, to be disciples and follow Him in compliance with His instructions. Keep in mind, He baptizes His disciples and empowers them with the Holy Spirit, Who also serves as our Guide, Teacher, and Comforter. Once we are “born of the Spirit” He puts a cross on our backs, and sets us on the narrow road of self-denial and obedience--a journey to eternity by which the saints can mature and grow into overcomers bearing love-based fruit that shows love for Him and our neighbor.

This is the bedrock of unsullied worship.The true, non-westernized Jesus (Yeshua) of Scripture, as compassionate as He is, wants committed disciples, not nominal converts or casual believers who contentedly straddle the two paths of life--wouldn’t you say, dear reader? There is no middle ground for the Called Out Assembly. The title Adonai–My LORD, well describes the non institutionalized, but rather a full-fledged living Torah–Yeshua – who asserts His rulership and requires the submission of His loyal followers–for their good and His glory. Are you one of them, dear reader?

We who honor His love-based instructions are destined to win! But be sure of this–He does not mince words. They are without equivocation. So here is another question: “Why do you [we] call Me [Him] LORD and not do what I say” (Luke 6:46). Friends, if we love Him we will love His clear and strong instructions also, and not find ways to avoid them such as we do with the fourth commandment. In failing to honor and thus follow His words, such as recorded in Matthew 7:24-27, we have become subpar “salt and light” and suffer spiritual and secular reproach–even though we might still produce good works.

We are created to glorify Yeshua. Therefore, let’s go beyond a relationship status and become genuine disciples and friends who go forward into a spiritual friendship-fellowship with our Savior. Remember His words: “My sheep hear my voice [they recognize His teachings], and I know them [in spiritual intimacy], and they follow Me [or they obey and live according to His pure teaching]” (John 10:27). Spiritual problems that were appearing in the nineteenth century have manifested greatly and are deeply rooted and affecting our culture today as well. Neither will they be squelched until the Body of Messiah embraces a whole truth revival. The roots of America’s spiritual and secular deterioration are deep, and the anti-Bible causes that were rising long ago are alive, enlarged, and producing bad fruit today. John 3:36. These are just a few examples of the rise and expansion of unbiblical doctrines and trends that sprang up from Torah-less faith foundations, and such unsettling trends are continuing and branching out today.

Again, the Ecclesia’s chief causes of doctrinal deterioration, denominational conflict, the mixing of falsehood with truth, the diversity of profitless errant doctrines, spiritual lawlessness, and a misunderstanding of Yeshua--are all the unholy products of rejecting the centrality of the Torah to our faith. Further, the shelving of the full ministry of the Holy Spirit and consequential subpar salt-and-light ministry are also the results of the historic rejection of the Law of Moses–which is the Torah. And let us be sure--the rich Hebraic faith culture and the believers’ Israelite identity are also centered upon the Torah—and are also missing. So, the Christendom colossus –- both Catholicism and Protestantism, abide spiritually subdued in this spiritual miasma and remain scripturally incomplete. Yet many Christians seem to not care. Nevertheless, the diversity of false doctrines that developed and followed the spread of the Gospel are existentially consequential. A reformation is absolutely needed—a restoration of Torah to the Ecclesia. Contenders are being summoned. You are one of them! Don’t back off. Start a Torah School in your home. We have the material for this wonderful undertaking.

Earth’s Cosmic Conflict and Restoring Apostolic Torah-based Faith involves you.

Reformation is occurring amidst the growth of two existential forces–Torah restoration and the AI Tech revolution. Our Reformation Report is designed to serve you by evaluating the messianic, Torah-based, faith restoration phenomenon that’s underway in the nation and chart its progress and impact within the realm of Christendom. What’s more, the Reformation Report will also unveil the Torah’s restoration’s benefit to both the modern Ecclesia, or nominal westernized Christianity, but also the crumbling American republic itself. Reformation is indeed occurring amidst the growth of two existential forces of social, even national reformation–Torah restoration and the AI Tech revolution.

Five Priorities for Advancing Disciples.

4. Read with the guidance of the Spirit of Messiah.This union should engender repentance, sanctification, and conformance to the instructions and commandments of Yahweh our Elohim. This commitment is required for real disciples.

5. Become open to Spiritual duty of contending for the original Nazarene, Torah–centered faith–known as “The Way.” This pentecostal faith was taught and modeled by the Messiah and His Apostles, and followed by the early disciples. Therefore, we contend for the restoration of this unadulterated spiritual model of biblical purity and practice. Thus, today’s modern Christians, professors of Messiah Yeshua who aspire to messianic discipleship, have important discipleship prerequisites, or essentials, to recognize and embrace.

Reminder: Whole Truth Restoration requires the Ecclesia--the Called-out-Assembly of Yeshua, who is the Living Torah, to turn converts into obedient disciples of the sacred Word! See Matthew 28:19 and 20; Romans 1:5 and 16: 26.

During your stay on earth let the joy of the LORD be your portion and holy conduct and godliness be your standard. 2 Peter 3:11. Dear follower of Yeshua--the following post examines the profile of westernized Christianity. It warrants our attention and a decision on the part of the readers, so you are encouraged to pay attention. Also, Contender’s Voice encourages every visitor and regular reader to prayerfully compare our presentation with New Testament history and the whole Word of God. And then make up their own minds concerning its accuracy and merit for personal application. Thank you, Hutch Church.

A Unique Post

This particular blog has a purpose. First, it is fashioned to encourage the existing Whole Truth Awakening that is occurring today among spiritually hungry, Spirit-led followers of Messiah Yeshua. Secondly, the article is intended to promote and contribute to the growing restoration of the original Torah-based, apostolic faith taught by Yeshua, proclaimed with power by his Apostles, and faithfully practiced by the early Judean disciples. This historic, biblical truth recovery must be continually revived by consistently presenting to unaware saints the origin, purpose, and transformative power inherent in the original faith foundations of the apostolic New Covenant Faith–called the Way. Its dynamic doctrines and historical works are recorded in the Book of Acts. The modern, westernized American Church of this hour–a varied, national colossus, resides far from the original, post-resurrection faith of the Book of Acts. And it is apparent that a large Scriptural gap separates the former faith from our popular and somewhat relaxed latter-day American faith. So let’s do something really unexpected, and explore the extent of this division, the spiritual debilitations it has caused, and the repairs that are needed. How do we do that? By comparing the westernized American Church with the U.S. Marine Corps regarding their adherence to their particular standards. Please understand--the contrasting of profiles is not a contest at all. Neither is it an attempt to glorify one corporate entity over another. Let me be clear--prejudice, competition and vainglory have no place in our juxtaposition exercise. However, honest exposure and analysis leading to the benefit of one or the other does. So, is such a procedure warranted? Yes! Did you know that comparing things–contrast their similarities and differences, their strengths and weaknesses--can be a powerful and effective method of evaluation and grading the loyalty of people or organizations to their specific values? Hence, this is our current blog's methodology.

Our two entities, or subjects–the western American Church and the United States Marine Corps, actually have some foundational similarities. The Marine Corps continues to hold steadily to its original doctrine, unity and commitments, even in the face of the cultural and governmental moral decline--and invasive wokism. It exemplifies loyalty. And we know the Christian Church has been faithful to take the Gospel light to the nations, spiritually enlighten people groups, and contribute to America’s founding and strong national character. Yet, the American Church–the denominations, their churches, ministers and people thereof, has been subjected to a gradual spiritual and moral decline for years. In fact, from its very beginning, Christianity has long suffered manifold, uncorrected problems resulting from settling itself on an unstable, Torah-less, unstable foundation, and now embraces degrees of doctrinal instability, and rejects the full ministry of the Holy Spirit. Thus it operates from a diminished potential, but one that can be quickly corrected. At this juncture though, denominational converts to Messiah Yeshua are still not being fully equipped as true disciples with whole-truth education. Juxtaposing will reveal more lucidly the prominent strengths, spiritual compromises, shortfalls, and restoration needs of either the Corps or our westernized Church. Blatant weaknesses must be addressed and corrected. We will do the contrasting and grading in Part Two, but first a confession.

I’m a 45 year follower and servant of Yeshua. I am also a former Marine, a veteran. Do these groups have anything in common concerning their enlistees? YES! Allow me to present a short testimony.

Welcome to Parris Island

In September, 1965, I stepped down from a Greyhound bus at the notorious Parris Island Marine Corps Recruit Depot in South Carolina. As I did a startling visage immediately gripped my attention! I was greeted by a large white sign that carried a foreboding message in bold black lettering. So too were the other wide-eyed, travel weary recruits “welcomed”--even everyone who accompanied me. The large, unavoidable wording declared: "The Marine Corps demands Discipline, Devotion to Duty, and Teamwork." The words requests, please, and thank you were conspicuously absent. Hence, I saw this in-your-face "hello" not merely as a strongly worded recommendation, but for what it actually was--a foreboding Old Corps ultimatum to be taken very seriously. Developing these character attributes was in fact an order that best be promptly comprehended and followed. At that time I had no idea that the Marine Corps’ espoused cohesive militant standards were entirely compatible with Scripture's requirements for aspiring disciples of Yeshua. In either case, the development of them would serve me well in the years to come. See Matthew 16:24.

Anyway, the unfriendly introduction caused my apprehension level concerning the future to spike! This took place during the days of the unforgiving Old Corps with its narrow and stifling wooden barracks, metal mess trays, nose-to-head lines, biting sand fleas, M-14 rifles, and tough male drill instructors--who did more than just scream at recruits. Indeed, there were other unpleasantries and punishments to endure. Nevertheless, we Marine hopefuls learned quickly to respect our leaders, follow orders, and fulfill our responsibilities.

In fact, the challenge was invigorating and bonded the recruits. That is how things should be for the saints as well, but usually are not. This has got to change! Messianic discipleship, without a doubt, requires effort, and personal religious standards that are in cadence with the Corp’s demands for–discipline, devotion to duty, and teamwork. Re-reading the Book of Acts is a good exercise because, by it, YHWH presents to believers a spiritual template for modern, nominal Christendom to start emulating now, not tomorrow! Acts reveals the first congregation of Spirit-born saints–the Nazarenes, their pristine faith, and unmixed spiritual values. Can we emulate them–the Marines and even the Nazarene saints also.? Yes we can, and will, and must.

Nonetheless, having been deposited on the inhospitable island--a place from which no recruits had ever successfully escaped, and pondering my irrevocable, vowed commitment to military service, I took the large, intimidating black-lettered words to heart and went forward mentally prepared to comply with the austere demands of the new chapter of life I had chosen. But unknown to me, my forbearance with the Corps' dominance, demands, and strict regulations--and the subsequent rigors of infantry life and combat in Vietnam, initiated a gradual inner transformation that would contribute to conditioning me years later for a life-changing encounter with the Holy Spirit, and conversion to the Messiah.

Beforehand however, I learned quickly how serious the Corps really was concerning its posted fundamental requirements. The large sign's stern message was indeed inflexible and vigorously enforced, as if it had been "etched in stone." There was no mincing of words; no equivocation! Separation from the old, worldly life and uniting with the new one was settled and there would be no "about face." Recruits--all who had sworn loyalty to the constitution and the service, would (a) learn and (b) march in step to ALL the Corps pertinent regulations and fulfill their duties in an honorable fashion! Failure of a Marine to obey a lawful order or standing regulation constitutes a violation of Article 92 of the Uniform Code of Military Justice. This arrogance–which you can regard as lawlessness, is called "Dereliction of Duty" and harsh punishments quickly accompany it. Ignorance of the law is no excuse.

Do you, my friend, observe overt dereliction of duty by the saints in knowing but not keeping the instruction of the Most High Elohim, our Commandant, so to speak? I think many, if not most, Christian claimants fall short of the Father’s expectations, but they seem apathetic anyway. And preoccupied by their own mixed spiritual pursuits. And therein lies the source of Christendom’s demise.

A Leatherneck and a Sheep

Since I am a former Marine, I have learned to appreciate the value and profit of the Corps’ demand that its recruits develop the excellencies of personal discipline, devotion to duty, and teamwork to be esteemed and active in one’s life. I am also a disciple of Messiah Yeshua with 45 years of ministry service behind me. Naturally, I promote the development and unfading loyalty to those same Marine Corps values to be found among the saints in the body of Messiah. Anyway, I think I am as qualified as anyone to conduct a brief and simple character comparison between the two entities based on their adherence to each one’s fundamental commitments. Humans are involved in each, and both groups can therefore undergo scrutiny and grading. One is of earthly origin and the other of heavenly--but both, for now, are earthbound. Thus, like others before me, I have fought against the enemies of both groups, using physical weapons as a Marine when required, and spiritual weapons as a Saint of the Most High when necessary also. The dark oppressors of freedom that confront both organizations are undergirded by the powers and deceptions of fallen angels and hordes of demonic spirits. Therefore, contrasting the compliance of each to their law and prime directives, devotion to duty, discipline, and team unity--will help believers assess the integrity of their associations and reflect on our own lives as well.

Conclusion: Our examination of how both the Church and the Marine Corps measure up—not to to one another, but to the same five mutual fundamental standards that will be revealed in our comparison to be posted in Part 2– which is next. There will be room for your evaluations and scoring conclusions also. Meet me there, brethren. Let’s finish together!

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom.

“Return to Me and I will return to you, says the Lord of hosts” (Malachi 3:7)

Purpose: To compare and grade the true-to-life quality of the discipline, devotion to duty, and teamwork found in each of these two historic companies.

Our Goal: To make plain the foremost need of today’s common saints.

I have a question to lay before you, brethren. It’s one that calls for a thoughtful and direct answer; not for beating around the bush. In fact, a little contemplation might sharpen your focus on our topic. Anyway, here it is: Does the spiritual ministry of today’s westernized Christian Church, as a whole, compare favorably with that of the original, apostolic Nazarene faith called the Way? You’ve read about this biblical faith in the Book of Acts. Remember, that was the first and only pristine New Testament faith “once for all handed down to the saints” and endorsed by Yeshua Himself. But it's missing today! In any case, “the Way” was Torah-centric, taught and modeled by the Apostles, followed diligently by Spirit-filled Jewish believers, was accompanied by miracles, testified to the validity of the Gospel, bore witness to the supernatural power of the Kingdom of God, and affirmed the resurrection of Yeshua our Messiah. See 1 Thessalonians 1:5; Jude 1:3. So, does the westernized American Church of this hour compare favorably with the authentic Called Out Assembly of the early Nazarene disciples? You can choose Yes or No for now. But our contrast between the westernized American Church and the U.S. Marine Corps will soon provide a clear answer.

Subscribe for free to get the audio.

Central Truth

Recruits must be made into fully trained Marines. Likewise, Converts of Yeshua must be made into fully equipped, narrow road disciples. I am happy to report that some progress is now being made toward satisfying this necessity of the modern Church. At this time, inspired messianic Christians are becoming genuine students of Yeshua their Teacher. And they are devoting themselves to His Torah-based instructions and to becoming loyal adherents to their Master’s Words--all that they learn. These fledgling disciples do not remain bonded to the mixed and varied doctrines of hundreds of denominational fathers, but they depart from them to make their spiritual aliyah to their blessed hebraic heritage. The Narrow Road is their chosen path, and the only one leading to the resurrection of the righteous and eternal life. The other pathway, of course, is the Broad Road that leads its travelers to condemnation, Hell, and eventually the Lake of Fire. Matthew 5:30; Mark 9:48; Luke 16:23; Revelation 19:20; 20:10, 14 and 15; 21:8. Keep in mind--Hell and the Lake of Fire are not symbols or metaphors. They are established realities. Yeshua referred to Hell more than He spoke of heaven, and warned people about these places and the many careless souls that will end up in them! He also spoke of Hell and outer darkness more often than anyone else in the Bible. Do not dismiss His warnings. Yeshua did not mince words. His teaching is beyond equivocation!

Obedience to religious dogma does not save anyone. We are saved only by faith in Yeshua the Son and His atoning blood. However, obedience to Yahweh’s sacred Torah instructions–which are reiterated in our Messiah’s New Testament teachings, is a true expression of salvation faith. Further, obedience–a concept shunned by most saints today, demonstrates love for God and for one’s neighbor. It also keeps us on the narrow road that leads to eternal life, transforms the soul, and develops friendship-fellowship with our Good Shepherd. What’s more, obedience opens heaven’s door to a great flow of blessing and vanquishes demonic strongholds as well.

Back to the Weigh In

This much is obvious. The Marine Corps record is open to a straight forward examination. Scrutinizing America’s westernized Church however requires a slightly closer look. The testimonies of (1) messianic believers, (2) the lawlessness of our spiritual and secular culture, (3) the growing Torah recovery movement, and (4) the prophetic Scriptures--all reveal modernized, institutional Christianity needs an honest evaluation and very likely a recalibration of its ecclectic theology and worldly faith practices and traditions.

Our culture has not been favored at all by America’s worldly institutional Christianity which, generally speaking, continues to suffer from spiritual and doctrinal alterations. That something is dreadfully wrong is evident. But by the grace of God a spiritual restoration movement is upwelling, as C.V. has reported. What we will discover in our three-part blog, I think, are valid reasons for this restoration occurring. For instance, the exiled Ten Tribe prodigals are returning--as prophesied, to the Father’s house, His instructions for life and worship, and to the older brother, Judah. See: Hosea 1, 3; Amos 9:9; Ezekiel 37; Jeremiah 3:11-18 and chapter 3; Isaiah 11:11-14; Luke 15:11-32, and 1 Peter 2:10 for starters.

Yahweh wants His people who claim Him as Savior and Lord to loose themselves from errant denominational doctrines and practices to follow His unmixed, pure instructions! Thus, messianic Christians are being summoned by the Holy Spirit to recover and restore the same faith that Messiah Yeshua modeled, taught His apostles, and who then passed it along to the Jewish disciples, and even Gentile converts. Yes, that call of recovery pertains to engrafted Israelites today. You and I, saints of the Most High Elohim, are first identified by the nation of our faith. That refers to every Spirit-born believer. Romans 11; 1 Peter 2:9. Thus it is written to you and to me…to all of us: “Therefore tell the people; this is what the Almighty says: Return to Me” (Zechariah 1:3). When believers finally get around to following His all instructions instead of cherry-picking only the laws they like or invent, their lives will prosper and demonic power will fade to the background!

Will our juxtaposition of military recruits and religious converts ignite an idea that converts to Messiah Yeshua would do well by attending some sort of tailored Bible Boot Camp? Do you, blessed reader, remember who was called to announce the appearance of the Savior to Israel? It was John the Baptist of the strict Essene community of faith. These were serious religious people who were waiting for the advent of the Messiah. Shouldn’t today’s Spirit-born believers be even more devoted to walking out their faith too? Yes! Perhaps a step-by-step program would help...something that would boost zeal and commitment, embrace genuine discipleship, inspire the study of the Torah, lead saints to be baptized with the Holy Spirit, honor the Sabbath and Moadim, and become familiar with other hebraic associations. We can’t love the world and His Kingdom at the same time, brethren. It’s one or the other. Compromise, a spiritual contaminant, is found in abundance along the Broad Road leading to destruction. In any case, such a promotion to ascend in spiritual maturity could carry a welcoming vibe, to use the parlance of the seventies, and awaken a holy ambition in many converts. When the disciples of old were called they were immediately stirred, and at once gave up their lives and silly “bucket lists” to travel with Yeshua and imbibe their divine Rabbi’s teaching and ways of life and ministry. Their journey of faith could be called a mobile boot camp, one might say. So what is it going to be, readers--our personal plans or His prophetic plans? What does your life reveal at this time?

Didn’t the Messiah say, “Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me [clearly--submit to my commandments]” (Matthew 16:24-27; brackets added by C.V.). For greater clarity, I present to you the Greek word for the English word, “follow.” It is hepomai. The Greek word means to obey. Further, re-read John 3:36. It uses the word believe which can be also translated as obey.

The sacred Scriptures are straightforward. We who follow the Messiah are ordered, not asked or cajoled, but ordered to submit to the Messiah’s personal lordship and sanctified lifestyle. It is for our welfare and His glory. He is Adonai–the eternal One with divine authority! Shouldn’t we who claim His as Lord turn around and start following Him now, and not later? We start by living in compliance with the truth (1) we know or have heard, (2) is applicable, and (3) doable--and go forward from that point. Or we stall!

Hence, honoring this commitment, which should be made at the point of one’s salvation, necessitates a complete identification with the life and righteous standards of Yeshua. In other words, disciples are expected to share the way, the truth, and the life of their Redeemer…and take these as their own, so to speak…and His powerful ministry also. Indeed, it is written: “For the Kingdom of God is not in word, but in power” (1Corinthians 4:20). In other words, the Kingdom of God, over which Yeshua is the Sovereign, is demonstrated through action and power, not just ongoing words or teachings. By the way…have you been baptized by Yeshua with the Holy Spirit? Every disciple should be, of course. Read Acts 1 and 2 again. Do you believe what occurred then is for you today?

Going Forward to the Comparison

Let’s make progress toward actually comparing the imposed but remarkable standards of the Marine Corp with those of the westernized American Church. Loyal adherence of each subject to the following five common standards will be evaluated and graded: (1) Discipline; Self-denial. (2) Devotion to Duty; Obedience to all official Orders. (3) Respect for Leadership and Unified Teamwork (4) Compliance to a Prime Directive (5) Mission Applications and Effectiveness.

Grades for loyalty to the five virtues of each of our two subjects will be posted in Part 3--which is next. Keep in mind as you read--Contender’s Voice vigorously promotes and contributes to the growing restoration of the original Torah-based, apostolic faith taught by Yeshua, proclaimed with power by his Apostles, and faithfully practiced by the early Judean disciples. This historic biblical truth recovery, though it continues to grow, must nevertheless be continually revived by consistently presenting to the saints who are not fully aware of their spiritual identity and heritage, prophetic purpose, and the transformative power inherent in the blessed faith foundations of the apostolic New Covenant Faith called the Way. Its dynamic doctrines and historical works are recorded in the Book of Acts, as mentioned earlier. Our comparison will reveal, and you will better perceive, the spiritual profile of the modern westernized American Church of this hour. It is a national colossus of varied doctrines and practices that devolved far from the original, post-resurrection faith of the Book of Acts. And it is thus apparent that a large Scriptural gap separates the former uncompromised faith from our popular and relaxed, institutional, manifold latter-day American faith. So let’s do something really unexpected, and explore the extent of this division and the spiritual debilitations it has caused, and the repairs that are needed. How do we do that? I repeat--it is by comparing the westernized American Church with the U.S. Marine Corps. Is such a procedure warranted? Yes! Did you know that comparing things–their similarities and differences, their strengths and weaknesses--can be a powerful and effective method of evaluation and grading people or organizations? Hence, this is our current blog's methodology.

Goal

Once this spiritual shortfall is evaluated and made apparent to our discerning readers, the exciting prospect of undertaking a new and challenging scripture based, truth journey that is solidly based upon the legitimacy of the Torah and the full ministry of the Holy Spirit, becomes very inviting. This appeals to many highly motivated believers. These zealous followers of Yeshua desire to regain footing on the Narrow Road, go forward on “new spiritual ground” in their faith journey, and regain a more intimate spiritual level of genuine holiness and friendship-fellowship with Messiah Yeshua and greater prophetic, endtime vision.

This was the goal of the early Nazarene saints who delighted by living and worshipping in full accordance with the Master’s holy truth. Therefore, the intention of Contender’s Voice is to promote and witness the fulfillment of the following three goals: First, to experience a broad based, enduring whole-truth revival; secondly, to witness the full restoration of the Holy Spirit’s uncompromised ministry and the Torah-centric truth to a large remnant of the Ecclesia; thirdly, to make true disciples “for the obedience of the faith.” At this point however, American Christianity, in great measure, has been tailored to comfort people, not to warn and challenge them about holiness and abiding on the Narrow Road. Let us understand–this road is trod by only a few saints–i.e., a scanty amount of believers. The rest, the “many,” are on the Broad Road leading to the Mark of the Beast and damnation. There’s no middle ground…not for them, or us.
