Question: Do you believe Yahweh our Elohim has limitless power and the ability to perform what seems impossible, and to act beyond human understanding or capability – even for you personally, dear reader? [1]

Well, here’s a comment for us to consider. Yahweh, our omniscient Creator, is doing something truly great for you, for myself also, and even for all those who follow Messiah Yeshua! He is fulfilling a spiritual need with a prophetically aligned undertaking that is motivated by His agape {unconditional} love, sublime wisdom, and immeasurable power. Be sure of this, however--His restoration work is inspired and led by the Spirit of God–not by a human teacher or a stand-out, mega ministry of some sort. Part 2

Yahweh wants the people who claim Him as Savior and Lord to loose themselves from errant, misleading denominational doctrines and practices, commit as His set-apart disciples, and follow His unmixed, pure instructions! Being immersed in westernized, doctrinally diverse Christianity is not supported by Scripture. It’s true that our nation's foremost religion has indeed made significant contributions to human progress throughout the world. But it has also drifted far from abiding with its original apostolic Nazarene moorings of spiritual power, Hebraic foundations, proclaiming the Torah-Gospel in the power of the Spirit and heralding the Kingdom of God, His righteousness, and the necessity of discipleship. Hence, modern, spiritually vitiated faith will eventually be left behind by zealous disciples who want an intimate fellowship with King Yeshua and all His Words. These ardent contenders can be expected to gravitate to groups and assemblies that have restored the Torah’s foundations of faith, welcomed the unabridged ministry of the Holy Spirit, and promoted the requirement of discipleship under the tutelage of the Messiah Yeshua. No excuses. No compromising. Matthew 28:16-20.

Yes, the call of recovery pertains to engrafted Israelites today. You and I, even all the saints of the Most High Elohim, are now identified by the national origin of our faith--Israel. That identity refers to every Spirit-born believer, everyone of whom the Almighty has equipped for bible-endorsed success and witness. Romans 11; 1 Peter 2:9. Thus it is written to you and to me…to all of us: “Therefore tell the people; this is what the Almighty says: Return to Me” (Zechariah 1:3). When believers finally get around to following all His instructions–that is, all of the Bible's Torah-rooted instructions we know and can follow, instead of cherry-picking only the laws we like, or can bend, or re-invent – then our lives will prosper and demonic power will fade to the background and dissipate. And we will be recognized as Savior’s “overcomers.” See Revelation 2-3.

Part 3

“What can the righteous do when the foundations [Torah based truth] are destroyed [broken and rejected]” (Psalm 11:3)?

Blessed friends, a Torah recovery is a must !

America has become a conflicted nation whose populace at large is confused, drawn to preferences but lacking in strong spiritual and moral convictions. Our traditional religious standards, that actually serve as cultural guardians and social chaperons so to speak, have been rejected. Our country’s spiritual and moral relapse has shaped its weakened character, the ghastly image of spiritually compromised, Torah-rejecting, Spirit resisting Christianity. Hence, our entire culture has become (1) subject to lawlessness–our foremost plague, (2) beguiled while living under a demonic spell, and (3) governed by a reprobate federal government, far-spread leftist bureaucracies, and unholy, parasitic foreign influences.

The manifold corruptions our country’s spiritual and secular institutions have suffered are inculpatory evidence of our desperate need for restoring the ancient foundations of our faith. Our hope? Yahweh is still alive and on His throne of grace. He remains faithful and compassionate, and will fulfill His prophetic Word for those who seek Him with their whole heart.. His promise remains: “Return to me {with heartfelt repentance} and I will return to you” (Malachi 3:7).

So, will our juxtaposition of military recruits and religious Christians raise the idea that converts to Messiah Yeshua would do well by attending small discipleship groups and, in unity, begin orienting their lives around Yeshua's commandments and calendar.

Is a zealous bride--probably a remnant of believers, beginning to prepare herself for her King’s return? We have an example of religious zeal based upon truth to inspire us and emulate. Remember who was called to announce the appearance of the Savior to Israel? It was John the Baptist of the strict Essene community of faith. These were serious religious people who were waiting for the advent of the Messiah. Shouldn’t today’s Spirit-born believers be even more devoted to walking out their faith? Yes! Take time and go to Matthew 11:11 for confirmation. Anyway, a step-by-step program would help...something challenging that would boost zeal and commitment, embrace genuine discipleship, inspire the study of the Torah, lead saints to be baptized with the Holy Spirit, honor the Sabbath and Moadim, and become familiar with other hebraic customs followed by the Messiah. It uses the word believe which can be also translated as obey.

By the way…have you been baptized by Yeshua with the Holy Spirit? Every disciple should be, of course. Read Acts 1 and 2 again. Do you believe what occurred then is for you today?
